name: Restaurant Goertz
address: 7F, JNC Building, 136-13 Tojeong-ro, Mapo-gu, Seoul, South Korea
description:
Restaurant Goertz is an elegant dining spot perfect for anniversaries or special occasions.

The interior offers a quiet, upscale atmosphere with beautiful night views, creating a memorable dining experience. Dishes are thoughtfully prepared and presented, complemented by attentive and friendly service.

With its reasonably priced menu, guests can enjoy a satisfying meal in a refined setting.

name: Suksungdo Jeju Main Branch
description:
Suksungdo (Jeju Main Branch) is a renowned restaurant specializing in Jeju black pork, offering a wide selection of premium cuts such as bone-in sirloin, pork neck, pork belly, and jowl.
What makes this place unique is its signature “cross-aging” method, which enhances both tenderness and depth of flavor, creating a truly distinctive taste experience.
Staff grill the meat for you at the table, ensuring it is served at its best, and side dishes like kimchi stew complement the pork perfectly.
With its spacious dining area, convenient parking, and reputation as one of Jeju’s must-visit restaurants, Suksungdo is a top choice for anyone seeking an authentic black pork experience.

name: Paldang Jokbal
description: Paldang Jokbal is a beloved dining spot renowned for its premium quality braised pig's trotters (Jokbal). Using only carefully selected domestic pork and fresh ingredients, the meat boasts a tender and chewy texture with rich, savory flavors. It's a perfect destination for both hearty meals and late-night drinking sessions, offering generous portions and a comforting dining experience.

name: Seoyang Myeonok Seosulla-gil
description: Seoyang Myeonok Seosulla-gil is a unique fusion dining spot that creatively blends Western techniques with traditional Korean ingredients. Located in the heart of the trendy Seosulla-gil, it is famous for its inventive dishes like Perilla Leaf Pesto Pasta and Grilled Pork Belly Risotto. The restaurant offers a warm, cozy atmosphere that perfectly complements the historic charm of the nearby Jongmyo Shrine stone walls.

name: Sedici
address: 1F, Seongsu-dong Arc Valley, 37 Seongsui-ro 22-gil, Seongdong-gu, Seoul, South Korea (Sedicci)
description:
Sedici is a popular restaurant in Seongsu-dong, best known for its Mascarpone Potato Gnocchi and Crab Bisque Risotto.

The gnocchi combines a rich potato flavor with a creamy sauce, while the risotto is both savory and refreshing.

Other favorites include the French Rack and Chorizo Carbonara, making it a great spot for a cozy and special dining experience.

name: ItalyJae
description:
ItalyJae – Authentic Italian Dining in a Hanok, Bukchon
ItalyJae is an authentic Italian restaurant featured in the Michelin Guide, located in the heart of Bukchon.
The restaurant stands out with its elegant Hanok-style exterior and cozy interior ambiance.
Signature dishes include sea urchin & salted pollack roe pasta and truffle cream gnocchi—favorites among regulars for their rich, luxurious taste.
Parking is available nearby at the National Museum of Modern and Contemporary Art or Jeongdok Library.
Attentive service and the chef’s meticulous care ensure a memorable dining experience.

*Please note that ItalyJae is a highly sought-after restaurant, and seats may become fully booked quickly.
Even with a reservation, your preferred time slot may close once capacity is reached.
As the restaurant observes a long break time in the afternoon, we kindly ask for your understanding when planning your visit.

name: Neuru Yeonnam
description:
Neuru Yeonnam is a beloved restaurant known for its diverse menu and cozy atmosphere.
The chuck flap steak is grilled to perfection, while the burrata cheese salad combines fresh tomatoes with creamy cheese.
Dishes like spinach gnocchi and gambas are also full of flavor, and set menus allow guests to enjoy a variety of offerings.

name: Goat Deli Seochon
description:
Goat Deli Seochon is a brunch café known for its Jambon-Beurre and pizzas.

The Jambon-Beurre balances the flavors of butter and ham, while the pizza features a chewy crust with a hint of truffle aroma. The Apple Bacon Sandwich is also a popular choice.

Located in a small alley in Seochon, the café offers a cozy atmosphere, and takeout orders are convenient with no waiting time.

name: Jeongsookseong
address: 1F, 31 Nambusunhwan-ro 226-gil, Gwanak-gu, Seoul, South Korea (Jeong Sukseong)
description:
Jeongsookseong (Sharosugil Main Branch) is a popular restaurant where you can enjoy a variety of pork cuts.
Each cut, from pork neck and pork belly to hangjeongsal (pork jowl), offers its own unique flavor and texture.
The hangjeongsal, in particular, is praised for its chewy texture and savory taste.

name: Gojip132 Seongsu
address: 1F, Daeyoung Building, 5 Wangsimni-ro 8-gil, Seongdong-gu, Seoul, South Korea
description:
Gojip132 Seongsu Main Branch is a specialty Korean barbecue restaurant located in Seongsu, Seoul. They focus on Jeju pork that is aged through a 132-hour low-temperature process, offering cuts like samgyeopsal, moksal, ddo kkisal (chewy pork cut), and the signature axe-rib (do-kki galbi).

The restaurant provides a grill-it-for-you service, which lets diners relax while staff handle the cooking. The interior is clean and cozy, making it suitable for dates or group meals. Note that there is a break time from 3:00 PM to 5:00 PM daily. It’s very close to public transit: just a 1–2 minute walk from Ttukseom Station Exit 7 or Seoul Forest Station Exit 1.

name: Egg and Flour
description: Egg and Flour is a Michelin Bib Gourmand-listed Italian restaurant in Haebangchon, famous for its exceptional fresh handmade pasta. As the name suggests, the chef uses only eggs and flour to create delicate textures that pair perfectly with unique sauces like Black Pepper Cheese or Lemon Butter. The restaurant also offers a stunning view of N Seoul Tower, making it a highly sought-after spot for a memorable and scenic dining experience.

name: Onhwa Dining
description:
Onhwa Dining Dosan is a fine Korean restaurant specializing in premium dishes such as Korean Beef Sirloin Steak and Pluma Pork Steak.

Seasonal summer specials include a Watermelon Salad and Chodang Corn Tart, while creative dishes like Handmade Dumplings add to the unique menu.

For dessert, the Yuzu & Grapefruit Ice Cream is especially popular.

name: Melting Shop X Cheese Room Gwanghwamun D Tower
address: 4F, Gwanghwamun D Tower Replace, 17 Jong-ro 3-gil, Jongno-gu, Seoul, South Korea
description:
Melting Shop X Cheese Room Gwanghwamun D Tower is a popular restaurant in Gwanghwamun, known for its creative dishes such as Spinach Flatbread and Earl Grey Tomato Caprese.

Using premium cheeses and fresh ingredients, the menu offers both great taste and health-conscious options. With its spacious interior and convenient parking, it is also well suited for group gatherings.

The Espresso Cheesecake is another favorite dessert among guests.

name: Pasta ta ta
address: 1F, Small House Big Door, 6 Namdaemun-ro 9-gil, Jung-gu, Seoul, South Korea
description:
Pasta Ta Ta is a restaurant well known for its wide selection of pastas and salads.

Among the favorites are the Arancini and the Burrata Cheese & Beet Salad, loved by many guests for their freshness and flavor. The restaurant is also noted for its use of fresh ingredients and stylish interior.

Other popular main dishes include Handmade Fresh Pasta and Grilled Iberico Pork Neck, making it a great choice for gatherings or date nights.

name: Concasse Anguk
description:
Concasse Anguk offers creative dishes that harmoniously blend Korean and Italian cuisine.

Highlights include the Pork Jowl Steak with Kimchi Purée, Doenjang Risotto, and Soy Sauce Marinated Crab Pasta, which leave a strong impression with their unique flavors.

Other favorites such as Lasagna and Potato Gnocchi are also well loved, while innovative dishes like Wasabi Pasta showcase the restaurant’s experimental flair.

name: Yosoojung
description:
Located near Daehung Station in Mapo, Seoul, Yosoojung is a fusion dining restaurant that combines the essence of Korean cuisine with the structure of Italian-style course dining. Tucked away on the second floor of a modest building, it offers a cozy, intimate atmosphere that feels like a hidden gem.

The defining feature of Yosoojung is its “leave it to us” omakase style. The menu changes daily depending on fresh seasonal ingredients, allowing the chef to create unique courses that blend Korean flavors with Italian techniques. From appetizers to mains and dessert, each course is thoughtfully composed to deliver a memorable dining experience.

The menu changes frequently, reflecting an omakase-inspired style where each visit offers a different culinary experience. Diners can’t predict exactly what will be served, which adds to its charm.

Excellent quality and creativity at a reasonable value
Daily changing menus with inventive ingredient pairings
A small, private, and cozy setting perfect for quiet dining
Recognized with accolades such as the Blue Ribbon recommendation
Limited seating means reservations are essential, and portions may feel modest to some guests

name: Palbala Samcheong
description:
Palbala Samcheong Main Branch is a restaurant specializing in French home-style cuisine.

Popular dishes include the French Onion Soup and Palbala Carbonara, while the Dutch Pancake topped with fruit and ice cream makes for a delightful dessert.

Guests can enjoy a cozy meal on the outdoor terrace, and the friendly staff ensure a pleasant dining experience.

name: Jeje
description:
Jeje is a well-regarded restaurant offering a variety of dishes such as Cantonese Beef Noodle Soup, Mapo Tofu, and Cucumber Salad.

The Dan Dan Noodles are mild enough for those sensitive to spices, while the Shrimp Cheung Fun and Xiao Long Bao are especially popular among the dim sum selections.

The Pickled Cucumbers are a must-have side dish, perfectly balancing out richer flavors.

name: Dark Bottle The Lounge Pub
address: 1F, 265 Neunghoe-daero, Yeonsu-gu, Incheon, South Korea (Dark Bottle The Lounge Pub)
description:
Dark Bottle The Lounge Pub is a cozy café where guests can enjoy a wide variety of coffee drinks.
Signature options include the original dabang-style coffee, caramel macchiato, and café mocha, with the dabang coffee especially praised for its rich aroma and flavor.

name: Myeongbong Lamb Skewers (Konkuk Univ. Main Branch)
description:
Myeongbong Lamb Skewers (Konkuk Univ. Main Branch) is a popular spot for enjoying a wide range of Chinese dishes and lamb skewers.
The signature lamb skewers are savory and tender without any gaminess, while dishes like creamy shrimp and chili shrimp are loved for their crispy texture and rich flavor.
Other highlights such as stir-fried eggplant and mapo tofu make it a great place to share and enjoy a variety of dishes together.

name: Matarello
address: Unit 120-6, 1F Retail, Building B, 203 Artcenter-daero, Yeonsu-gu, Incheon, South Korea
description:
Matarello is a restaurant that blends Italian cuisine with brunch favorites.
Its main menu features dishes like Margherita pizza, bacon potato pizza, and truffle gnocchi, while a variety of brunch options such as sandwiches, pancakes, and salads make it a versatile spot for any occasion.

name: Nightfall
description:
Nightfall is a cozy restaurant and wine bar located near Busan National University.
By day, it offers a casual café-like atmosphere, and by evening it transforms into a stylish spot for dining and drinks.
Menu highlights include Western-style dishes such as steak, paired with a variety of wines.
With its artsy interior and warm ambiance, Nightfall is a popular choice for dates and evening gatherings.

name: Seoyang Myeonok
address: 1F, Unit 101, 43 Yeonhui-ro 1-gil, Mapo-gu, Seoul, South Korea
description:
Seoyang Myeonok in Yeonnam-dong is a popular restaurant often with waiting lines, known for its flank steak and pasta dishes.
The flank steak is especially well-regarded for its tender, juicy texture and is served with roasted baby potatoes for a highly satisfying meal.

name: Musch
address: 2F, Johan Building, 25-5 Hangang-daero 52-gil, Yongsan-gu, Seoul, South Korea
description:
Mushi is a popular restaurant located in Samgakji, well-known for its unique menu items such as the Lion’s Mane Mushroom Hamburg Steak and Green Onion Pizza.

The combination of Lion’s Mane mushrooms with a Japanese-style hamburg steak is refreshing and creative, while the green onion pizza stays delicious even after it cools, offering a truly distinctive flavor.

The interior is bright, clean, and charming with plenty of natural light, and it features a range of seating options from solo tables to larger group spaces, making it a comfortable spot for anyone to visit.

Situated in Itaewon, within Yongsan.

name: Tongro
address: 1F, Unit 101, 25 Gangdong-daero 55-gil, Gangdong-gu, Seoul, South Korea
description:
Tongro captivates guests with a wide variety of dishes that recreate the authentic flavors of Thailand.

From Pad Thai Goong to Tom Yum Ramen Hot Pot and Khao Mu Tod (fried pork), each dish stands out for its rich spices and fresh ingredients.

The interior is stylish yet cozy, and with every dish being flavorful, many guests enjoy ordering several items to share.

name: Sutimoon
address: B1, 27-8 Gukjegeumyung-ro 8-gil, Yeongdeungpo-gu, Seoul, South Korea
description: Sutimoon is a premium modern Korean dining restaurant in Yeouido that reinterprets traditional Korean flavors with a focus on charcoal grilling. The restaurant offers a refined multi-course experience featuring high-quality seasonal ingredients prepared over an open flame, creating a sophisticated harmony of smoky aromas and elegant presentation. Its chic, dark-toned interior provides an exclusive atmosphere, making it a perfect destination for business meetings or special celebrations.

name: Odihyang
description:
Odihyang is a bibimbap specialty restaurant where a Korean chef prepares each dish daily with fresh ingredients.
The menu features a variety of options, including bulgogi bibimbap, yukhoe (beef tartare) bibimbap, mulberry leaf bibimbap, and the signature five-flower bibimbap, which combines healthy ingredients with a beautiful floral garnish.
Served with neatly prepared side dishes, the meals are light, clean, and satisfying.

name: Puff Room
address: 1F, Unit 101, 454 Dosan-daero, Gangnam-gu, Seoul, South Korea
description:
Puff Room is a popular restaurant offering a wide variety of dishes in a comfortable atmosphere.

Guests can enjoy full course meals from appetizers to desserts, with many signature items especially well loved.

The spacious interior and generously arranged seating make it an excellent choice for gatherings, and valet parking adds convenience. Friendly staff and prompt service ensure a satisfying dining experience.

name: Palmfarmbali
address: 2F, 185 Seongmisan-ro, Mapo-gu, Seoul, South Korea (Pampam Bali)
description: Palm Palm Bali is a breezy, sun-lit dining spot inspired by Balinese holiday vibes, tucked away in Yeonnam-dong. The mushroom longanissa, trasi oil pasta and Jimbalan butter shrimp are particularly loved, while the Iberico steak and the wine-list curated with care also draw attention. The food is imaginative yet naturally balanced in flavour, paired with warm and attentive service that makes the visit feel like a mini escape.

name: Dosleubak
description:
Dosleubak is a Korean dining restaurant that combines both flavor and atmosphere.

Its signature Dakgomtang (chicken soup) features a clean yet rich broth enhanced with Cheongyang chili oil, making it especially flavorful. The Boiled Chicken served with a complementary dipping sauce is also a highlight.

name: Just Tendong
address: B1F, 3 Donggyo-ro 46-gil, Mapo-gu, Seoul, South Korea
description:
Just Tendong Yeonnam Main is a cozy Japanese-style restaurant specializing in tempura rice bowls and udon.
The Just Tendong, Special Tendong, and Ebi Tendong are especially popular, with crispy tempura served over warm rice.
The compact space has a simple, authentic interior, making it suitable for solo diners or small groups.
It operates daily from 12:00 to 21:00, with a break time between 15:00 and 17:00.

name: Mangata
description:
Mangata is based on Scandinavian cuisine, with a stronger focus on Swedish dishes.

One of the signature menus is Swedish meatballs (Köttbullar), served with mashed potatoes, cream sauce, and raspberry pickles as part of the course meal.

It is a Nordic-style course dining experience hidden in the quiet alleys of Bukchon.
With only a small number of tables, it offers a serene and private atmosphere, combining the elegance of a renovated traditional Hanok interior.

Reservations tend to fill up quickly, so we recommend booking at least 30 days in advance.

<Reservation Types>

Mangata Course Reservation (1–8 guests): Chef’s tasting menu featuring 5 courses.

Mangata À La Carte Reservation (1–4 guests): Scandinavian à la carte dishes, modern interpretations of Swedish-based ingredients and techniques.

Notes:

One bottle corkage is free per table when ordering the course menu.

Please inform us in advance if you have allergies to shellfish, nuts, or other ingredients.

The restaurant is open to guests aged 14 and above only.

For course reservations, signature dishes cannot be mixed with other options.

Korean Hanwoo sirloin must be requested in advance at the time of reservation.

If you arrive late, your dining time may be shortened due to subsequent reservations. The designated course dining duration is 1 hour 30 minutes to 2 hours.

Break time is from 3:00 PM to 5:00 PM.

Closed on Mondays and Tuesdays.

name: Hitsujiya
address: 1F, 126 Hangang-daero, Yongsan-gu, Seoul, South Korea (Hitsujiya Yongsan Branch)
description:
Hitsujiya Yongsan is a Japanese-style restaurant in Seoul specializing in lamb dishes.
Its all-you-can-eat lamb and lamb chops are especially popular, praised for their tender texture and clean flavor without any strong gaminess.
At lunch, the menu expands to include set meals such as Jingisukan steak, sukiyaki, curry, and mazemen, offering both variety and value.
With its cozy Japanese-inspired interior and relaxed atmosphere, Hitsujiya is a favorite spot for casual dates, group gatherings, or anyone looking to enjoy quality lamb in the heart of Yongsan.

name: Casa Italia
address: 10 Jahamun-ro 8-gil, Jongno-gu, Seoul, South Korea (Casa Italia)
description:
Casa Italia is a restaurant that serves refined and delicious Italian cuisine.

The Truffle Cream Gnocchi is a customer favorite, loved for its soft texture and rich, nutty flavor. Another highlight is the Aglio e Olio Pasta, made with fresh ingredients for a light taste and perfectly chewy noodles.

name: Grino Seongsu
address: 1F, Unit 103, 147 Seongsui-ro, Seongdong-gu, Seoul, South Korea
description:
Grino Seongsu is a popular restaurant in Seongsu-dong, best known for its white ragù pasta and octopus dishes.
The romesco octopus, served with scallops and romesco sauce, is a standout, while the banana pudding is a favorite sweet dessert.
Other recommended items include the flank steak and gnocchi, and guests can enjoy watching the cooking process in the open kitchen while dining.

name: Lalakey Dining
description: Lala & K is a restaurant offering great-value omakase courses with wine pairings for lunch and dinner. With a refined yet private atmosphere, it’s an ideal choice for dates or special occasions

name: Nambu
description:
Nambu is a Korean barbecue restaurant offering a wide selection of pork cuts, including Aged Samgyeopsal (pork belly), Pork Neck, Pork Shoulder Blade (Gabrisal), and Pork Jowl (Hangjeongsal).

The meat quality is excellent, with the Gabrisal and Hangjeongsal especially popular for their juicy flavor and great texture. Staff grill the meat to perfection, and the restaurant is so popular that there is often a wait.

Guests can also enjoy a variety of meal options such as Stuffed Cucumber Noodles and Doenjang Rice Stew alongside the barbecue.

name: Acid House
description: Acid House is a Sinsa restaurant offering Nordic-inspired dishes, from sourdough and shrimp smørrebrød at brunch to beef tartare and scallops at dinner. The lemon basil pasta is especially popular, and the clean, balanced flavors and relaxed atmosphere make for an enjoyable dining experience.

name: Tosokchon Samgyetang
description:
Tosokchon Samgyetang is a famous restaurant specializing in ginseng chicken soup, a traditional Korean health-boosting dish.
Popular menu options include wild ginseng root samgyetang and black chicken samgyetang, while side dishes such as rotisserie chicken and seafood pancake add variety.
The seafood pancake, filled with fresh seafood and scallions, is crispy yet moist, and the restaurant’s kimchi pairs perfectly with the hearty chicken soup, making it a highly satisfying meal.

name: Sovs Hannam
description:
Soves Hannam is well-known for its variety of salmon-based dishes.
The salmon steak pairs perfectly with a creamy sauce, while the spicy salmon roll is loved for its addictive flavor.
With a cozy and inviting atmosphere, it’s an ideal spot for dates or special occasions, and the friendly service adds to the overall experience.

name: Mattdol
address: 1F, Unit 3, 63 Seongdeokjeong-gil, Seongdong-gu, Seoul, South Korea
description: Mattdol Seongsu Branch is a Michelin Bib Gourmand restaurant specializing in taco omakase. The chef, who trained in Mexico, hand-makes the tortillas, and the tasting course features a variety of creative tacos at a reasonable price. The cozy and stylish interior makes it a great spot for dates or special dinners.

name: Goat Deli
description:
Goat Deli Mullae is a brunch café popular for its Jambon-Beurre, a variety of sandwiches, and pizzas.

Standout items include the Jambon-Beurre, Gorgonzola Mushroom Pizza, and Apple Bacon Sandwich, all made with fresh ingredients. The Soup of the Day is also a guest favorite.

Side dishes such as house pickles and coleslaw pair perfectly with the sandwiches. With its spacious, stylish interior and friendly service, the café offers a comfortable dining experience.

name: Baro Pasta Market
description:
Baro Pasta Market is a restaurant known for its delicious pasta and risotto dishes.
The bacon cream pasta is rich and savory, while the seafood tomato pasta impresses with fresh seafood and a smoky flavor.

name: Puerco Gwanghwamun
address: B1F, Puerto, The Exchange Seoul, 21 Mugyo-ro, Jung-gu, Seoul, South Korea
description:
Puerco Gwanghwamun is a high-end barbecue restaurant located in the basement of The Exchange Seoul in Jung-gu. It specializes in premium aged Korean beef and Beyota-grade Iberico pork, offering a refined dining experience in a spacious setting.

The restaurant features 38 private rooms and some 470 seats, making it suitable for both intimate dinners and group gatherings. Staff directly grill the meat for customers using a 1:1 dedicated grilling system, and the space is equipped with a downward exhaust system to keep the air clear.

At Puerco, diners can bring their own wine or whiskey without charge thanks to the corkage-free policy. The establishment also offers building parking (first 2 hours free) for convenience.

name: Yabai
description:
Yabai is a popular restaurant in Hongdae where you can enjoy Japanese-style okonomiyaki and monjayaki.
Monjayaki, a dish not commonly found in Korea, is known for its nutty, mild flavor.
Other favorites like yakisoba and okonomiyaki are also well-loved, made with fresh ingredients and rich sauces.
The Japanese-inspired interior and music add to the atmosphere, making it feel like a short trip to Japan.

name: Wolyoil
description: Wolyoil is a popular izakaya known for its diverse menu and inviting atmosphere. Signature dishes include mackerel pressed sushi and truffle mushroom pasta, while everything from the complimentary starters to the main dishes is consistently satisfying. Spanning two floors, the second floor offers spacious seating ideal for group gatherings. With friendly staff and a warm, lively vibe, it’s a great choice for dates or small get-togethers.

name: Yakitori Yoisa
description: Yaki­tori Yoisa is a buzzing izakaya-style spot in the Garosu-gil / Sinsa area of Seoul where you can enjoy a rich variety of charcoal-grilled chicken skewers. Signature picks include the hatsu (chicken heart), negima (chicken thigh with scallion), and tsukune (chicken meatball) — each charred over open flame for a satisfying smoky flavour. The food strikes a perfect balance: flavourful and indulgent, yet not overly heavy, letting the quality of the chicken and ingredients shine through. The lively yet intimate atmosphere and warm, attentive service make it a fantastic choice for a casual dinner, a date, or drinks with friends.

name: Crab 52
description: Crab52 & Shabu52 is a premium seafood buffet located in COEX, Samseong-dong, perfect for special occasions. Guests can enjoy an all-you-can-eat seafood course while taking in panoramic views of Seoul. The clean, upscale interior and attentive service enhance the dining experience, making it an ideal spot for both families and couples.

name: Patic
description:
Patic is a restaurant known for its unique menu, featuring dishes such as Clam Escargot, Octopus Salad, and Sweet Potato Gnocchi.

The Sweet Potato Gnocchi, served with a creamy and nutty sauce, is especially popular, while the Octopus Salad stands out for its fresh ingredients and elegant plating.

Every dish is prepared with care and full of flavor, making it a great choice for special occasions. With its friendly staff and charming atmosphere, it is also highly recommended as a date spot.

name: Doinong
description:
Doinong offers modern reinterpretations of traditional Thai cuisine.
Its Tom Yum Goong stays true to authentic Thai flavors, with bold spices and tangy notes that fans of the dish especially love.
Other highlights like Pu Nim Pad Phong Curry (soft-shell crab curry) and Moo Krub (crispy pork) are made with fresh ingredients and outstanding taste.
With a spacious interior and comfortable seating, it’s also well-suited for group dining.

name: Growers
description:
Growers, located in Yeonhui-dong, is a popular brunch spot known for its diverse menu and stylish interior.

Among its signature dishes, the creamy Pistachio Gnocchi and Burrata Cheese Salad stand out for their fresh ingredients and harmonious flavors.

The menu also includes hearty options such as Prime Galbi and Iberico Pork Neck, giving diners an even wider variety to choose from.

name: New Wave Seoul Kondae
address: 28-10 Achasan-ro 33-gil, Gwangjin-gu, Seoul, South Korea (New Wave Seoul)
description:
New Wave Seoul Kondae is a restaurant specializing in Italian cuisine and steaks.

The Chuck Flap Tail Steak highlights the rich flavor of fresh beef, while the Pork Jowl Steak is known for its tender texture and unique sauce.

Other popular dishes include Blue Cheese Cream Gnocchi and Perilla Oil Green Onion Pasta. With its stylish interior, the restaurant is highly recommended for dates and gatherings.

name: Tableview
address: 1F, Unit 102, 18-8 Sinheung-ro 15-gil, Yongsan-gu, Seoul, South Korea
description:
The Exquisite Flavor of Salmon Pasta
Table View offers a variety of dishes crafted with seasonal ingredients, from today’s pasta specials to burrata with roasted squash, and spicy shrimp creations.

Our salads are filled with fresh vegetables and seasonal fruits, making them both healthy and delicious.
For meat lovers, the lamb steak and beef steak are juicy, tender, and sure to satisfy.

Closed on Tuesdays
It is located in Itaewon, Yongsan.

name: Sookhee
description:
Sookhee is a whiskey bar located in Chungmuro, offering a unique cocktail experience featuring Kavalan Single Malt Whisky.

The Pineapple Cake Cocktail combines Taiwanese Kavalan whisky with pineapple for a perfect balance, while the addition of blood orange adds a refreshing twist.

With both bar and table seating available, it is well suited for dates or small gatherings. Guests especially appreciate the bartender’s warm hospitality and the bar’s distinctly Korean ambiance.

name: Shonino
description:
Shonino is an Italian brunch and dining restaurant located near Yongsan/Shinyongsan, offering a wide range of dishes from brunch items to risotto, pasta, and steak.

The interior is bright with lemon-colored accents, creating a Positano-inspired atmosphere. Though the space is small, it is designed to feel cozy and inviting.

name: Gogigul Yeongdeungpo
description:
Gogigul Yeongdeungpo offers a unique dining experience centered around premium aged Korean meats and charcoal grilling in a warm, intimate setting.

The restaurant features a bar-style counter layout, where every guest is seated close to the grill. Skilled chefs personally prepare and grill each cut of meat over charcoal, ensuring optimal flavor, tenderness, and juiciness throughout the meal.

Gogigul specializes in high-quality, locally sourced Korean beef (Hanwoo) aged for 21 days and premium Korean pork (Handon) aged for 14 days. Their signature dish is the pork neck, known for its rich flavor and exceptional tenderness. Other popular choices include sirloin, pork belly, and specialty cuts with unique textures.

In addition to its expertly grilled meats, the restaurant also offers a curated selection of beverages, including sake and traditional Korean liquors, making it a perfect place to enjoy both food and drinks in a relaxed yet refined atmosphere.

name: Vino Paradise Hannam
category: Italian bistro and wine bar style
description:
Vino Paradise, the place where G-Dragon once celebrated his birthday. Vino Paradise Hannam is a restaurant offering a wide range of dishes, from appetizers and mains to pasta, sides, and desserts.

Guests can enjoy diverse flavors and textures in every dish, such as Braised Oxtail, Red Sea Bream Steak, and White Ragu Pasta. With its calm and comfortable atmosphere, it is also an excellent place for conversation.

It’s the perfect spot to celebrate special occasions, especially when pairing the recommended dishes with a glass of wine.

The restaurant is located near Exit 1 of Hannam Station and is closed every Sunday.

name: Sunmi Happy Crab Jang Dongdaemun
address: 2F, 38 Eulji-ro 43-gil, Jung-gu, Seoul, South Korea (Sunmine Haengbok Gejang)
description:
Sunmi’s Happy Crab Jang Dongdaemun Branch is a seafood restaurant specializing in Soy Sauce Marinated Crab, Spicy Marinated Crab, and Shrimp Jang, all made with fresh ingredients.

Guests can enjoy unlimited refills of various marinated crab dishes, along with a wide selection of side dishes such as Grilled Salted Shrimp and Fried Crab.

name: Plant
description:
Plant Itaewon is one of the most well-known vegan restaurants in the Itaewon area, offering a wide variety of healthy and delicious dishes.
The Hummus Salad Bowl and Teriyaki Bowl combine both nutrition and flavor, while the Mushroom Burger and Tofu Caesar Wrap are unique vegan options that are loved by many.

In particular, the Tofu Caesar Wrap, with its cashew Caesar dressing and crispy fried onions, is a true highlight.

name: Garden Poet
address: 12 Wausan-ro 14-gil, Mapo-gu, Seoul, South Korea (Garden Poet)
description:
Garden Poet is highly recommended for both brunch and dinner.

The Scallop Basil Pesto Pasta and Langoustine Bisque Pasta are rich in flavor, made with plenty of fresh seafood. Fresh options like the Burrata Cheese Salad and Caesar Salad are also available for a lighter, healthier choice.
For something indulgent, the Truffle Cream Risotto paired with the Grilled Salchisal Steak offers a truly refined dining experience.

Located near Hongdae

1. Hall Reservations
Seating options include tables for 2 guests, 3–4 guests, and group tables for 5–8 guests.
Please make your reservation according to the number of people in your party.

2. Annex Room
For reservations of 4 to 10 guests, the Annex Room requires a minimum spend of KRW 200,000.

3. Poet Atelier Room
For 2 to 4 guests, reservations for the Poet Atelier Room require a minimum wine order of KRW 200,000 in advance.

4. Poet Living Room (Private Dining)
For 12 to 18 guests, the Poet Living Room Private Dining option requires a minimum spend of KRW 500,000.

name: Oxsoban Magok
address: 1F, Units 123–124, 45 Magokjungang 6-ro, Gangseo-gu, Seoul, South Korea
description:
Oxsoban Magok (Main Branch) is a shabu-shabu and sukiyaki specialty restaurant located in Magok, Seoul. The restaurant operates daily from 11:00 AM to 10:00 PM, with a break time from 3:00 PM to 5:00 PM on weekdays.

The menu focuses on sukiyaki and shabu-shabu, with meat cut fresh to order and generous free refill of vegetables. Basic side dishes such as cabbage salad, kimchi, and pickles are included. Ordering is facilitated with a tablet system at each table.

The interior is sleek and elegant—ideal for romantic dinners or group meals. Because of its popularity, it's common to experience waiting, so reservations are recommended. The restaurant has also undergone expansion to improve its space and service.

name: Gohyang Lamb Skewers
description:
Gohyang Lamb Skewers Kondae is a specialty restaurant famous for its lamb skewers and lamb rib skewers.
The lamb rib skewers are the most popular item, while the fried eggplant is crispy and flavorful, making it a great pairing with beer.
With a spacious interior and private rooms, it’s well-suited for group gatherings or more private dining experiences.

name: Sentinel
description: Sentinel is a brunch café in Sinsa known for its Dutch baby pancake and bacon-cheese sandwich, with popular mains like marbled steak and mala cream pasta. The food is flavorful yet light, and the spacious, stylish interior makes it great for gatherings. With valet parking and a café-to-wine-bar transition in the evening, it offers a relaxed, versatile dining experience.

name: Common Mansion
description: Common Mansion is a sophisticated brunch and dining spot located in the serene Gyeonghuigung area of Jongno. Known for its stylish interior and high-quality seasonal ingredients, it offers a refined menu ranging from hearty sandwiches and fresh salads to flavorful pasta dishes. It is an ideal place to enjoy a peaceful meal or a relaxed coffee break while soaking in the quiet, historic atmosphere of the neighborhood.

name: Wolhwa Sikdang
description:
Wolhwa Sikdang is a renowned Korean BBQ restaurant in Mapo, specializing in premium YBD black pork cuts such as pork belly, pork jowl, and skirt meat.
The signature beeswax-aged pork belly, available by reservation, highlights the restaurant’s focus on quality and uniqueness.
Attentive staff grill the meat for you, and the seasonal side dishes, handmade condiments, and warm atmosphere make it a favorite spot for both locals and travelers.

name: Onsuban
description:
Onsuban Seonyudo is a Korean restaurant specializing in a variety of warm noodle soups and rice bowls, such as Rice Noodles in Cold Broth, Brisket Noodles, and Tendon Noodles.

Another favorite is the Boiled Beef Shank Slices, served with a special soy sauce.

With an open kitchen that highlights cleanliness and a selection of drinks including single pours and traditional Korean liquor highballs, it’s a great place to enjoy both food and drinks.

name: Jikajangin sinsa
address: 1F, Unit 102, 62 Dosan-daero 1-gil, Gangnam-gu, Seoul, South Korea
description: Jikhwa Jangin (Sinsa) is a premium charcoal-grill restaurant in Gangnam’s Sinsa-dong, where you can savor a variety of high-quality grilled pork cuts. Their flower neck meat (꽃목살) and aged special pork skewer set are especially popular, while the crispy pork belly and succulent pork cheek also stand out. The flavors are rich and smoky without being overwhelming, accentuating the meat’s natural juiciness and texture. Paired with attentive, professional service, dining here feels both indulgent and refined.

name: Atteutteu
address: 1F, 42-5 Donggyo-ro 38-gil, Mapo-gu, Seoul, Seoul, South Korea (Atteutteu)
description:
Atteutteu is a specialty restaurant offering a wide range of unique hot pot rice dishes, from cockle soy-marinated crab rice and octopus rice to Eonyang-style bulgogi rice and braised pork belly rice.
The abalone hot pot rice is nutty and mild, while the sea bream butter rice pairs perfectly with simmered radish for added flavor.
With neatly prepared side dishes, it’s an ideal spot for a wholesome and satisfying meal.

name: Moot
address: B1F, Unit B101-2, 100 Hangang-daero, Yongsan-gu, Seoul, South Korea
description:
Moot is especially popular for its Jambon-Beurre and Hummus Sandwich, both known for their fresh ingredients and unique flavor combinations.

The Fresh Fruit Juices, made with seasonal fruits, add a refreshing touch, and each menu item comes with detailed descriptions, making it easy to choose.

With its clean interior and friendly service, the restaurant offers a comfortable dining experience.

name: Ugomi
description: Ugomi is a sophisticated modern fine dining restaurant located in the trendy area of Mapo-gu. Reinterpreting traditional Korean flavors with contemporary culinary techniques, it offers a beautifully structured course meal that transitions seamlessly from amuse-bouche to dessert. Featuring a sleek interior with intimate counter seating and private dining rooms, it is an exceptional destination for romance, special anniversaries, or important gatherings.

name: Low n Slow
description:
Low & Slow is a restaurant known for its meat dishes and a variety of plate options.
Popular items include wagyu brisket, beef ribs, and pulled pork, while chicken wings and homemade sausages are also well-loved.
The tender, flavorful meat combined with a stylish and cozy interior makes it a great place to visit with family or a partner.

name: Piroz
description:
Piroz is a popular café known for its French toast and a variety of brunch dishes.
The cream cheese French toast and double cheese toast are especially loved, while unique drinks like the bagel latte and melon jelly ade add to its charm.

name: Daramgee
description: Daramgee (meaning "squirrel" in Korean) is a cozy and charming traditional Korean liquor bar located along the picturesque Seosulla-gil stone wall walkway. They offer a great selection of premium makgeolli and traditional spirits, paired beautifully with modern Korean tapas such as crispy savory pancakes (jeon) and seasoned raw meat (yukhoe). The warm, inviting atmosphere makes it a perfect spot to relax and enjoy the unique vibes of Jongno.

name: Alpero
description:
Alpero Hongdae is an Italian restaurant located on the 2nd floor of the Nine Brick Hotel in Hongdae.
Known for its truffle-infused cream pastas and premium steak sets, it offers a refined dining experience with European-style interiors and warm lighting.

Signature dishes include the Truffle Cream Pasta, Classic Tomato Pasta, and Marinated Chuck Flap Steak — each beautifully plated and prepared with rich flavors.
Guests can also enjoy full-course steak sets and handmade Basque Cheesecake for dessert.

With elegant indoor seating, terrace options, and private dining rooms, Alpero Hongdae is ideal for dates, small gatherings, or special celebrations.

name: Elloco
description:
Elloco Seongsu is a modern Spanish restaurant and wine bar located in Seongsu-dong, offering authentic Mediterranean-inspired tasting courses in a refined setting.

The Lunch (₩40,000) and Dinner (₩60,000) tasting menus are especially popular, featuring standout dishes such as Squid Ink Paella, Charcoal-Grilled Iberico Pork, Half Chicken, and Elloco Gnocchi — all prepared with rich Spanish sauces and fresh seasonal ingredients.

By choosing a set menu, guests can enjoy a wide variety of dishes at a reasonable price, paired perfectly with a curated selection of Spanish wines.
With its sleek black-toned interior and private ambiance, Elloco Seongsu is an ideal destination for date nights, anniversaries, or intimate gatherings.

Reservations are available for both lunch and dinner, lunch bookings are accepted for one or more guests, while dinner reservations require a minimum of two.

name: Maeumjib
address: 2F, Unit 202, Episode Building, 37 Hangang-daero, Yongsan-gu, Seoul, South Korea (Maeumjip)
description:
Maeumjib is is a Korean-inspired wine bistro located in Yongin-dangil, known for its creative fusion dishes and curated wine pairing.
The menu bridges Korean ingredients and Western techniques, featuring unique items like Grilled Oysters, Uni Manchego Cheese Pasta, Hanwoo Doenjang Tartare, and Flower Short Rib Ragu Pasta.

With its balanced mix of local flavors and fine-dining presentation, Maumzip offers a sophisticated yet comfortable dining experience.
Guests can enjoy thoughtfully paired wines with each dish, complemented by cozy two-story seating and a modern interior.

name: Buccelli House
description:
Buccelli House is a fine dining restaurant in Hannam-dong where guests can enjoy a variety of premium aged steaks in an elegant, private setting.
Signature cuts such as the Striploin, Tenderloin, and Ribeye are known for their juicy flavor and tender texture, available in customizable 100-gram portions.
Both the Lunch and Dinner Courses feature full-course pairings with wine and refined side dishes, offering a true fine dining experience.
Dinner for two typically starts from around KRW 200,000, and advance reservations with a deposit are recommended due to limited seating.

With its classic interior, soft lighting, and attentive service, Buccelli House is the perfect venue for anniversaries, business meetings, or any special occasion.

name: Woo Tender
description: Woo Tender is a premium Korean BBQ restaurant in Sinsa specializing in top-grade 1++ Hanwoo beef. Signature cuts like tenderloin and ribeye are especially popular, offering rich flavor and exceptional tenderness, while dishes such as beef tartare are also well-loved. The meat is expertly grilled to highlight its natural juiciness, and the clean, upscale atmosphere with attentive service creates a refined and memorable dining experience.

name: Hanwoodream
address: 1F, 297 Gosanja-ro, Seongdong-gu, Seoul, South Korea (Hanwoo Dream)
description:
Hanwoodream Main Branch is a premium Korean beef (hanwoo) omakase restaurant located in Seongdong-gu, Seoul. The restaurant operates two dinner sessions per evening (18:00–20:00 and 20:20–22:20) and is closed on Sundays.

Their fixed-price course (around 110,000 KRW per person) features a variety of high-quality beef cuts—such as tenderloin, sirloin, striploin, and specialty cuts—alongside meat sashimi, yukhoe (beef tartare), and complementary rice or soup dishes.

The interior is sleek and elegant, with well-spaced seating and private rooms available for special occasions. Staff are attentive, providing detailed explanations and precise cooking of each cut. Valet or paid parking behind the restaurant is available for guests.

name: Rangt Yeonnam
description:
Located in Yeonnam-dong, Rangt blends Korean and Western flavors through creative reinterpretation of familiar ingredients.
Signature dishes include the Sous-vide Pork Belly Steak, aged for tenderness and rich umami, the Miso Green Onion Cream Gnocchi, and the Red Crab Bisque Shrimp Risotto — each beautifully plated with balanced flavors of depth and creaminess.

Other favorites like the Spicy Cream Pasta and Minari Salmon Salad highlight the restaurant’s modern, flavorful twist on comfort dining.
With a selection of sangria, wine, and craft beverages, guests can enjoy perfect pairings in a warm, sophisticated setting.
The bright and cozy interior makes Rangt Yeonnam an ideal destination for anniversaries, casual gatherings, or relaxed dining with friends.

name: Cine de Chef Apgujeong
address: B5F, CGV New Building, 45 Apgujeong-ro 30-gil, Gangnam-gu, Seoul, South Korea
description:
Cine de Chef Apgujeong is a fine-dining restaurant located inside Apgujeong CGV, offering dinner courses along with dishes like seafood pasta and lobster.
The seafood pasta with tomato sauce and the tenderloin steak are especially popular, while the Basque cheesecake served as dessert pairs perfectly with coffee.

name: Ilgwa Sarm Sai Teum
address: 1F, 17-9 Wonnohyeong 5-gil, Jeju-si, Jeju-do, South Korea (Work & Life Gap)
description:
Ilgwa Sarm Sai Teum is a Jeju-based restaurant loved for its creative pastas and gnocchi made with local ingredients.
Standout dishes include abalone and bracken pasta and shrimp oil pasta, which highlight Jeju’s regional flavors.
The menu is complemented by sides like Caesar salad and tomato-based mussels, making it a well-rounded dining experience.

name: De Foret Wine & Bistro Yongsan
description: De Foret Wine & Bistro is a hidden gem nestled in a quiet alley of Yongsan, renowned for its sophisticated and natural ambiance. It offers an exceptional dining experience with a great selection of wines that perfectly complement its signature dishes, such as tender steak and savory pasta. With its carefully curated music and stylish interior, it is the perfect spot for a romantic date or a memorable evening gathering.

name: Localit
description:
Localit is a vegetable-centered restaurant in Oksu-dong that offers creative European-style dishes made with fresh seasonal ingredients.
The menu features flavorful vegetarian and vegan options such as the Vegetable Terrine Plate, Pumpkin Cannelloni, Eggplant Lasagna, and Spinach Gnocchi, along with a few well-balanced meat dishes like Korean Beef Ragù and Sirloin Steak.
Each dish is light yet deeply flavorful, showcasing the natural taste of fresh produce with refined sauces and beautiful plating.
With its cozy yet elegant atmosphere and friendly service, Localit offers a healthy and satisfying fine-dining experience where vegetables truly take the spotlight.

name: Monarch Bistro
address: 3F, Merry Monarch, 145-57 Jamwon-ro, Seocho-gu, Seoul, South Korea
description: Monarch Bistro is a stunning waterfront restaurant located on the 3rd floor of Merry Monarch at Jamwon Hangang Park. It offers breathtaking panoramic views of the Han River, making it an exceptional destination for romantic dates, family gatherings, or casual brunch. The diverse menu features Western favorites including premium steaks, fresh pasta, risotto, and a variety of brunch options, with the Provence Salad and Tomato Mozzarella Pasta being local favorites. It is also well-known for being a pet-friendly venue.

name: Yungong Korean Bistro
description:
Yungong Korean Bistro is a restaurant known for its unique Korean fusion dishes.

The Yukhoe Pasta, combining fresh beef tartare with perilla oil sauce, offers a delicate harmony of flavors, while the Spicy Vongole Sooljjim (clam stew with Korean liquor) is loved for its bold and warming taste.

The Doenjang Ragu Pasta, made by slow-cooking meat and vegetables with Korean soybean paste, delivers a rich and deep flavor.

Other popular dishes include Potato Pancakes and Cream Sujebi (hand-pulled noodle soup), with all menu items offered at reasonable prices.

name: Venetti
description: Venetti is an elegant and upscale Italian restaurant located near Sinnonhyeon Station in the vibrant Gangnam area. Boasting a spacious main hall and private dining rooms, it serves as an ideal venue for celebratory gatherings, group dinners, and special occasions. The menu features exquisite dishes prepared with premium ingredients, including Hanwoo Beef Carpaccio, Truffle Porcini Risotto, and Hanwoo Striploin Steak, all of which pair beautifully with their extensive selection of wine, draft beer, and coffee.

name: Ritardando
address: B1F, 393 Ttukseom-ro, Seongdong-gu, Seoul, South Korea (Ritardando)
description:
Ritardando is a popular restaurant in Seongsu, best known for its Flap Steak and Burrata Corn Salad.

The steak features a tender texture and rich flavor, while the salad highlights the perfect harmony of fresh corn and creamy burrata cheese.

With soft lighting and a stylish interior, it offers a cozy yet elegant atmosphere, making it an excellent place to enjoy a meal paired with wine or cocktails.

name: Snack Bar Sage
description: Snack Bar Sage (Eobu Bar) is an izakaya known for its fresh seafood and carefully aged sashimi. The sashimi, prepared with ingredients sourced daily from the market, offers deep umami and refined flavors. Guests can enjoy an immersive experience at the U-shaped counter, where the chef presents and explains each dish, with the omakase-style aged sashimi being especially popular.

name: Aus
description:
Aus is a café and restaurant located in Ara-dong, Jeju, known for its fresh, seasonal ingredients.
Popular dishes include katsu sando, jambon sandwich, and Jeju lemon butter tagliatelle, while desserts like nectarine mousse and Jeju raspberry pavlova are guest favorites.
The menu also offers a variety of drinks, from coffee to seasonal kombucha.

name: Hamban
description: Hamban is a hamburg steak specialty restaurant near Hapjeong Station, best known for its “Moa Hamban” set that lets you enjoy chicken, pork, and beef hamburg steaks in one meal.

name: Malbang Gukbap Yongsan
description:
Malbang Gukbap Yongsan Main Branch is a restaurant where guests can truly enjoy the rich flavor of premium Korean beef. Popular dishes include Yukhoe Bibimbap, Raw Beef Slices (Mungtigi), and Beef Sashimi, all known for their freshness.

The Cold Beef Mulhoe is highly recommended in summer for its refreshing taste, while specialties such as Grilled Intestine Sundae and Beef Tendon Suyuk are also favorites among diners.

name: Wuga
address: B1F, 22 Dosan-daero 49-gil, Gangnam-gu, Seoul, South Korea
description:
Wuga, located in Apgujeong, is a popular Korean BBQ restaurant known for its aged prime ribeye and beef brisket. The yukhoe bibimbap, made with fresh beef tartare and a flavorful sauce, is also highly recommended.

With its casual yet refined atmosphere and attentive, friendly staff, Wuga has become a favorite spot for both locals and visitors — including K-pop idols such as BTS and BLACKPINK who are known to dine here.

name: Jinjung Beef Noodle House
address: 75-2 Cheonggyecheon-ro, Jongno-gu, Seoul, South Korea (Nirou Mianguan Main Branch)
description:
Jinjung Beef Noodle House (Main Branch) offers a variety of dishes alongside its signature beef noodle soup, including Yu Xiang Eggplant, Sweet and Sour Pork, and Mapo Tofu.

The Mapo Tofu is especially popular for its perfect balance of tender tofu and flavorful seasoning, while the Yu Xiang Eggplant stands out with its crispy texture and savory sauce.

With a clean interior and friendly staff, the restaurant provides a pleasant dining experience.

name: Pinch Brunch Bar
description: Pinch Brunch Bar is a vegan restaurant where you can enjoy a variety of plant-based dishes made with fresh, wholesome ingredients. The hummus salad and pesto pasta are especially popular, while the curry gnocchi is also well-loved. The flavors are vibrant without being heavy, allowing the natural taste of the ingredients to shine, and the relaxing terrace and bar-table seating create an easy, comfortable dining experience

name: Pizza Forzza
description:
Pizza Forzza (Mangwon Main Branch) is a cozy Italian restaurant serving both pizza and pasta.
Known for its heart-shaped pizzas and flavorful dough that keeps guests eating to the last bite, the menu offers a wide variety of choices.
Popular side dishes include Caesar salad and steak cream lasagna, while the spacious seating and warm atmosphere make it a comfortable dining spot.
Parking is available at nearby public lots.

name: Jejugot Seogwipo Seafood Ramen
address: 36 Chilsimni-ro 214beon-gil, Seogwipo-si, Jeju-do, South Korea (Jejugot Seogwipo Seafood Ramyeon)
description:
Jejugot Seogwipo Seafood Ramen is a popular restaurant known for its fresh and generous seafood toppings.
Signature dishes include octopus ramen and creamy seafood ramen, both packed with ingredients like octopus, shrimp, and mussels for a rich, flavorful broth.
Crispy tempura and kid-friendly pork cutlets make it a great choice for families.
Located near Jeongbang Waterfall, the restaurant offers convenient parking and friendly service, making it an ideal stop before or after sightseeing.

name: Ixchel
description:
Ixchel Hapjeong Main Branch specializes in Mexican cuisine, with fajitas being the most popular dish.

You can enjoy them by wrapping grilled vegetables with a choice of beef, chicken, or shrimp in warm tortillas. The Sweet Potato Guacamole and Mexican Caesar Salad are also highly recommended side dishes.

The restaurant offers a spacious interior with comfortable seating and a pleasant atmosphere, making it an excellent spot for both dates and family gatherings.

name: Arp
description:
Arp, located in Yeongdo, Busan, is a Michelin-recognized restaurant known for its unique interior design and wholesome menu.
Creative vegan-friendly dishes such as pani puri, chipotle hummus, bracken pasta, and chamnamul pasta are especially popular.
With fresh ingredients, elegant plating, and a selection of desserts like house-made gelato and refreshing ades, Arp is a perfect choice for special occasions.

name: Osteria Yoon
description:
Located near Gwangalli Beach, Osteria Yoon offers refined Italian dining crafted by a chef from Seoul’s Michelin scene.
Signature dishes include Truffle Beef Carpaccio, Fresh Prawn Bisque Pasta, Mascarpone Basil Pizza, and Vongole Pasta, the latter generously topped with fresh clams and rich seafood flavor.
The maple wood–smoked Hanwoo sirloin steak adds a distinctive aroma and depth, creating a perfect balance between modern flair and traditional Italian sensibility.
With a warm, elegant interior that evokes the feeling of dining abroad and an extensive wine list for perfect pairings, Osteria Yoon invites guests to enjoy a sophisticated yet comfortable coastal dining experience.

name: Bits Bits Hongdae
address: 2F, 120 Eoulmadang-ro, Mapo-gu, Seoul, South Korea (Bits Bits)
description:
Bits Bits Hongdae is a well-known restaurant famous for its Gyukatsu and pasta dishes.

The Sirloin Gyukatsu and Pollock Roe Cream Pasta are especially popular, combining tender beef with a rich, creamy pasta sauce.

With spacious seating and an outdoor terrace, it offers a cozy atmosphere, making it a great choice for a date spot.

name: Vera Hannam
address: SPC Building, 272 Itaewon-ro, Yongsan-gu, Seoul, South Korea
description:
Vera Hannam is a well-known restaurant offering a variety of Italian dishes made with fresh ingredients.

The Sea Urchin Rose Pasta is especially popular—often described as a “life-changing pasta”—while the Pomodoro & Arugula Pizza delights guests with its fresh arugula and the chewy texture of handmade pasta.

name: Duomo
description:
Duomo is a hidden gem in Seochon, best known for its delicious gnocchi and fresh salads.

The interior is charming and beautifully decorated, and guests can use the Cheongwadae Sarangchae parking lot nearby.

Dishes can be ordered à la carte or as a course, with seasonal options such as Seasonal Salad and Eggplant Tomato Gratin.

With its refined atmosphere, Duomo is a great place to enjoy authentic Italian cuisine in style.

name: Tapacopa
description:
Tapacopa offers modern reinterpretations of traditional Spanish tapas.
The Pulpo and Tenderloin Tartare are especially well-known, showcasing fresh ingredients and unique cooking methods that bring depth of flavor.
Desserts like the Basque Cheesecake are also popular, and the cozy atmosphere makes it a great place to enjoy a wide variety of dishes.

name: JangsuboGam
description:
JangsuboGam Sinchon Main Branch is a Korean restaurant specializing in samgyetang (ginseng chicken soup) and other chicken dishes. Popular options include Ban-gye-tang (half chicken soup), classic samgyetang, perilla seed samgyetang, herbal chicken soup, and dakdoritang (spicy braised chicken).

The restaurant is open on weekdays from 10:30 AM to 8:30 PM, with a break time from 3:30 PM to 5:00 PM. On Saturdays, it operates from 10:30 AM to 3:30 PM, and it is closed on Sundays.

name: Yukmong Hongdae
description:
Yukmong Hongdae Main Branch is a Korean BBQ restaurant where you can enjoy both pork and beef.
The pork neck is especially popular for its juicy and tender texture, while the honeycomb pork skin and egg kimchi fried rice are also customer favorites.
Staff grill the meat for you and provide friendly service, ensuring a comfortable dining experience.

name: Gyeokjeong Mullae
description:
Gyeokjeong Mullae Main Branch is a popular spot specializing in grilled chicken cuts cooked over charcoal. The skirt meat stands out for its chewy texture, while the neck meat is praised for its tenderness.

Both salted and marinated grills are clean and flavorful without any gaminess, and sides like Makguksu (buckwheat noodles) and Fried Rice are also well loved.

With its trendy atmosphere and reasonable prices, it’s a great place to visit with family or friends.

name: Jinjag
description:
Jinjag is a Japanese restaurant offering a wide variety of dishes such as Futomaki, Kaisen-don, and Beef Short Rib Rice Bowl.

A highlight is the Pork Jowl Rice Bowl, featuring a perfect combination of bean sprouts, scallions, and egg yolk. The Assorted Katsu is also popular, showcasing the tenderness of both sirloin and tenderloin cuts.

name: Yukdodam Apgujeong
description:
Yukdodam Apgujeong Rodeo Branch is a popular spot for enjoying aged Jeju pork.

The menu features a variety of cuts, including Aged Samgyeopsal (pork belly), Pork Neck, and Pork Shoulder Blade, with specialties like Flying Fish Roe Fried Rice with Salted Hairtail Intestine Sauce and Spicy Bibim Naengmyeon being especially popular.

The spacious second floor offers a comfortable dining atmosphere, with both parking and valet service available. For lunch, options such as Kimchi Stew, Naengmyeon, and meat set menus make it a great choice for office workers as well.

name: Kkotbap Epida
description:
Kkotbap Epida is a Korean restaurant offering a variety of course meals such as Grilled Beef, Grilled Pork Neck, and Steamed Rockfish from Heuksando, along with vegan options.

The Steamed Rockfish is especially popular for its tender texture and light, clean flavor that pairs well with rice, while side dishes like Stir-Fried Chili Pork are also well loved.

With a range of seating options, including group tables, the restaurant is well suited for family gatherings or small get-togethers.

name: Fabri Kitchen
description:
Fabri Kitchen is a popular restaurant known for its wide-ranging menu and reasonable prices.
Dishes like lamb sirloin steak, bruschetta, and risotto are prepared with fresh ingredients and great care.
Each table has a tablet for convenient ordering, and payment is made at the counter.

name: 37.5 Signature
description: 37.5 Signature is a modern brunch dining café where you can enjoy a wide variety of Western-style dishes made with fresh ingredients. Signature items include French toast, lemon pancakes, and gourmet black burgers, while dishes like omelet rice, pasta, and soups are also well-loved. The menu is generous and comforting without being overly heavy, highlighting the quality of the ingredients, and the bright, stylish interior creates a warm and inviting dining experience.

name: Joyonghan Jutaek
description:
Joyonghan Jutaek is a cozy restaurant best known for its Hanwoo Sirloin Steak and Parisian Gnocchi.

Other popular dishes include the Fresh Pasta White Ragù and Shrimp Bisque Pasta, making it a great spot to enjoy a special meal in a warm and intimate atmosphere.

name: Moyeon Mapo
address: 1F, Youngwoo Building, 318 Tojeong-ro, Mapo-gu, Seoul, South Korea (Moyeon Mapo Main Branch)
description:
Moyeon Mapo Main Branch is a premium Hanwoo (Korean beef) restaurant with elegant interiors and private rooms, making it ideal for family gatherings or important occasions.

The menu features aged Hanwoo cuts such as tenderloin and sirloin, paired with refined Korean dishes like Pyeongyang Cold Noodles and Doenjang Stew. A highlight is the Yukhoe (beef tartare), uniquely served with salmon roe and pine nuts for a distinctive flavor.

name: Gilmok Main Building, Annex
description: Gilmok is a well-known Korean BBQ restaurant near Cheongdam Station, featuring a spacious main building and an annex located side by side. The signature top-grade pork neck is served with a generous assortment of grilled vegetables that balance the richness of the meat, while popular sides like steamed egg and onion spaghetti add extra comfort to the meal. With excellent ventilation and convenient parking nearby, it offers a relaxed and pleasant dining experience.

name: Chonnom
description:
Chonnom is a popular restaurant in Daehak-ro, known for its specialty meat cuts and yukhoe (Korean-style raw beef).
The hangjeongsal (pork jowl) is loved for its chewy texture and savory flavor, while the yukhoe mulhoe (raw beef in cold broth) is fresh and generous in portion.
Set menus offer a wide variety of options, and the cold noodle soup with kimchi broth makes the perfect refreshing finish.
Since the meat is served grilled, you can enjoy your meal conveniently without smoke or heat.

name: Vollare
address: Seonghun Building, 8 Sapyeong-daero 20-gil, Seocho-gu, Seoul, South Korea
description:
Vollare is an authentic Italian restaurant run by a chef formerly from Il Cipri, known for dishes that highlight the natural flavors of the ingredients. Popular choices include the Margherita Pizza and Truffle Butter Fresh Pasta.

Located in Seorae Village, it offers convenient parking and valet service, allowing guests to enjoy their meals in an elegant yet comfortable setting.

name: Labo Steakhouse
address: 31 Dosan-daero 59-gil, Gangnam-gu, Seoul, South Korea (Labo Steakhouse)
description:
Labo Steakhouse Cheongdam is a fine restaurant renowned for both its steaks and seafood dishes.

The Caesar Salad, included in the lunch course, features fresh romaine, cheese, and thick-cut bacon in perfect harmony, while the additional Crab Cake is especially delightful with its crisp texture.

With its elegant atmosphere and attentive service, it is an excellent choice for celebrating special occasions.

Please note that the restaurant observes a prep time from 3:00 PM to 5:00 PM daily.

name: Museo
address: B1, 20 Gangnam-daero 47-gil, Seocho-gu, Seoul, South Korea
description: Museo is a creative fusion Korean restaurant located near Yangjae Station. It offers a diverse dining experience, ranging from a premium Korean set menu (baekban) for lunch to an elegant signature tasting course and a luxurious VIP king crab course for dinner. The restaurant is highly acclaimed for its inventive dishes, such as tender braised beef short ribs (sogalbi-jjim), North Korean-style steamed chicken, and a unique potato-shredded ice cream, all of which can be beautifully paired with curated traditional Korean liquors.

name: Camillo Lasagneria
address: B1F, 41 Donggyo-ro 12-gil, Mapo-gu, Seoul, South Korea
description:
Camillo Lasagneria in Hapjeong is an Italian restaurant specializing in homemade lasagna and fresh pasta.
The Emiliana lasagna combines rich tomato sauce with creamy cheese, while the Montagna lasagna is known for its deep, hearty flavor.
The flap steak, grilled and oven-finished, offers a perfectly crisp outside and tender inside, and pairs well with pasta dishes like basil agnolotti.

name: Hoochoo Point
description:
Hoochoo Point is a conveniently located restaurant near Gangnam Station, best known for its truffle-scented Potato Gnocchi and signature Steak.

The Kimchi Fried Rice offers a spicy yet refined flavor that many guests recommend, while the friendly service and clean, modern interior add to the overall dining experience. The menu features a harmonious blend of Korean and Western cuisine.

Reservations are available for 2–4 guests at specific weekday times: 11:00 AM, 2:00 PM, and 5:00 PM. Please note that the restaurant has a prep time from 4:00 PM to 5:00 PM daily, and on weekends reservations may require additional waiting time.

name: Confier
address: B2F, Grand Central, 14 Sejong-daero, Jung-gu, Seoul, South Korea
description:
Confier is a fine dining restaurant where guests can enjoy an elegant meal at a reasonable price.

Both the lunch and dinner courses are praised for their excellent flavor and presentation, and diners can choose from a variety of seating options, ranging from private rooms to bar seats.

name: Yeongilli
description:
Yeongilli is a stylish restaurant offering brunch sets, pasta, and fresh salads.
The burrata cheese salad stands out with its rich flavor and crisp vegetables, while main dishes like gravy beef chop steak and basil cream guanciale pasta are also popular choices.
With an elegant yet comfortable interior, it’s an ideal spot for dates or gatherings.

name: Pimpi Itaewon
description:
Pimpi Itaewon is a stylish restaurant in Itaewon, best known for its Chive-Chop Lamb Ribs and Fettuccine Toowoomba Pasta.

The Salad Pasta, prepared with a special sauce, makes for a great appetizer, while the Spicy Cream Risotto is rich yet not heavy, earning it plenty of praise.

name: Osteria Secondi
address: 1F, Unit 102, 4-9 Baekjegobun-ro 42-gil, Songpa-gu, Seoul, South Korea
description:
Osteria Secondi is an elegant Italian restaurant, perfect for anniversaries or date nights.

The menu includes a wide variety of dishes such as Hanwoo Tartare, Ragù Tagliatelle, and Bistecca Steak, along with popular desserts like Tiramisu and Fruit Sorbet.

name: Northern Lights
address: 1F, 55-2 Seongmal-ro 53beon-gil, Namdong-gu, Incheon, South Korea (Northern Lights)
description:
Northern Lights is a brunch café that perfectly combines great taste with a stylish atmosphere.
Menu highlights include pistachio butterscotch latte, seasonal fruit pavlova, soy chili chicken steak, and pork shoulder salad steak.
With its modern interior that’s perfect for photos and attentive, friendly service, it offers a satisfying dining experience for every guest.

name: Jeongdamun Bossam Bukchon
description:
Jeongdamun Bossam Bukchon is a Korean restaurant known for its tender, odor-free boiled pork wraps (Bossam), perfectly paired with spicy Bibim Noodles.

The menu includes a variety of options such as Octopus Bossam and Jeju Black Pork Bossam, along with side dishes like Chive Pancakes and Clam Soup, making it a hearty and satisfying meal.

name: Lucid Seoul
address: 1F, Unit 101, 45 Samil-daero 32-gil, Jongno-gu, Seoul, South Korea
description:
Lucid Seoul is well known for its brunch menu made with fresh ingredients and care.

Popular choices include Avocado on Toast, Eggs Benedict, and the Australian Big Brekkie, with the Eggs Benedict being especially loved by many guests.

name: Base
description:
Base (Baje) is a cozy Italian restaurant near Sadang Station / Bangbae that specializes in fresh handmade pasta.

The menu features a variety of pasta dishes such as Carbonara, Genovese, and Pomodoro, along with risotto, salads, and desserts. Meals usually begin with fresh ciabatta bread served with ricotta cheese and olive oil.

The restaurant has a small, intimate setting with bar-style seating and an open kitchen, allowing diners to watch their dishes being prepared. Its calm and inviting atmosphere makes it a popular choice for dates and casual gatherings.

Operating hours are from 11:50 AM to 2:30 PM for lunch (last order 1:30 PM) and 5:30 PM to 9:30 PM for dinner (last order 8:30 PM), with a break time in between. The restaurant is closed on Mondays.

Due to its limited seating and popularity, reservations are recommended, and seasonal menu variations are often available.

name: Thegiwa Apgujeong
address: 1F, 15 Seolleung-ro 155-gil, Gangnam-gu, Seoul, South Korea (THE GIWA)
description:
Thegiwa Apgujeong Main Branch is a modern Korean pub that reinterprets traditional dishes and drinks.
The kalbi bibim noodles pair wonderfully with bossam, while the mille-feuille nabe is a flavorful hot pot made with fresh, healthy ingredients.
They also offer a wide variety of traditional drinks, including matcha makgeolli and homemade misutgaru makgeolli.
Reservations are available for two or more people.

name: Manbae Arirang Bossam
address: 1F, Gangseo New Tower, 24 Hwagok-ro 18-gil, Gangseo-gu, Seoul, South Korea (Manbae Arirang)
description:
Manbae Arirang Bossam Main Branch is a bossam specialty restaurant best known for its Oyster Bossam and Hongeo Samhap (fermented skate served with pork and kimchi).

The combination of fresh oysters, tender boiled pork, and well-fermented skate creates an exceptional flavor. Kimchi Bossam and Cabbage Bossam are also popular choices.

Meals are served with side dishes such as Doenjang Jjigae (soybean paste stew) and Kalguksu (hand-cut noodle soup), making for a hearty dining experience.

With convenient parking and friendly staff, it offers a comfortable and satisfying atmosphere.

name: Orno Yongsan
description:
Orno Yongsan is an Italian restaurant with a cozy atmosphere, known for dishes made with fresh ingredients such as Ricotta Grape Salad, Margherita Pizza, Arrabbiata Pasta, and Truffle Squid Ink Fried Octopus.

The Arrabbiata Pasta stands out for its spicy kick, while the Fried Octopus combines a crispy texture with rich truffle aroma.

With a wide selection of wines to pair with the menu, it is an excellent choice for evening gatherings.

name: Ushiya Seongsu
description:
Ushiya Seongsu is a Korean beef omakase and yakiniku restaurant located in Seongsu-dong. It offers thoughtfully curated set courses featuring premium cuts and special beef parts such as beef sashimi, beef tongue, tail roast, tripe, and more.

The restaurant operates from 5:00 PM to 11:00 PM on weekdays and is closed on Mondays. On weekends, they also offer lunch service. Since there is no dedicated parking, guests need to use nearby public parking facilities. The interior is cozy and warmly lit, with both bar-style seating and table options, creating an intimate and refined dining atmosphere.

name: Hoksi
address: Unit 101, 40 Wonnohyeong 3-gil, Jeju-si, Jeju-do, South Korea (Shutter Moon)
description:
Hoksi is a unique restaurant located in New Jeju, offering a refined dining experience with both set and à la carte options.
Signature dishes include authentic carbonara and Iberico steak, while the Mont Blanc dessert, with its elegant plating, has become a popular highlight on social media.

name: HeyVert
address: 1F, Unit 101, 25 Serae-ro 6-gil, Seocho-gu, Seoul, South Korea
description:
HeyVert is a café with a nature-inspired interior and a relaxed atmosphere, best known for its Burrata Cheese Salad and Tomato Cold Pasta.

It operates with counter service and has restroom facilities inside for convenience. A long central table creates a sense of openness, and the menu—prepared with fresh ingredients—offers rich and satisfying flavors.

name: Cheondeokho
address: Unit 70, Cheondeok-ho, 12 Soraeyeok-ro, Namdong-gu, Incheon, South Korea
description:
Cheondeokho is a popular sashimi restaurant located inside the Sorae Port Fish Market in Incheon.
It is known for its fresh and generous seafood platters, featuring options like flatfish, rockfish, salmon, and seasonal specialties such as king crab and snow crab.
Set menus often include a variety of side dishes—like assorted tempura, seafood pancakes, and spicy fish stew—creating a full Korean-style dining experience.
With convenient parking and easy access from Soraepo-gu Station, Cheondeokho is a great choice for travelers who want to enjoy authentic Korean sashimi culture in a lively fish market setting.

name: Podowon Heukdwaeji
address: 51 Sumokwon-gil, Jeju-si, Jeju-do, South Korea (Podowon Black Pork)
description:
Podowon Heukdwaeji is a Jeju restaurant specializing in black pork, perfect for gatherings with family or friends.
It offers a variety of cuts including pork belly, neck, jowl, and shoulder at reasonable prices, with side dishes like kimchi stew and soybean paste stew adding extra flavor.
The spacious and comfortable setting, friendly service, and convenient parking make it a must-visit dining spot during any trip to Jeju.

name: Nops
description: Nops Jamsil is a steak house and Western cuisine restaurant located in the Sanghakseo-ro area of Songpa-gu, Seoul. Its signature offerings include premium steaks like T-bone, served alongside a variety of pasta dishes such as Gambas Oil Pasta and Arrabbiata. The restaurant is known for its elegant interior and occasional lake views from window seating. Customers praise its unique side dishes—such as perilla oil kimchi—and the refined, classic dining atmosphere. With reservation options and parking availability, it’s a solid choice for both date nights and upscale meals.

name: Munch
description: Munch is a cozy Italian-casual dining bar near Samgakji in Yongsan, housed in a renovated home with warm wood and white interiors. Led by a CIA-trained chef from New York, it serves creative Italian-fusion dishes such as Pecorino Cheese Rigatoni with pork jowl and pepper leaves. With limited seating and high demand, reservations are recommended. Perfect for a relaxed yet refined dining experience.

name: Sasanoha
description: Sasanoha is a popular izakaya located near Seokchon Lake, offering a unique Japanese dining experience. Originally a standing bar (tachinomi), it now provides a mix of comfortable seating and standing areas. Known for its incredible value, the menu features highly affordable and delicious sushi, fresh daily sashimi, and creative dishes like ceviche. With its vibrant atmosphere, it is a great spot to enjoy a casual evening with drinks.

name: Prego Club
address: B1F, 1-10 Sangwon 2-gil, Seongdong-gu, Seoul, South Korea
description:
Prego Club is a restaurant famous for its authentic Italian-style Carbonara and Vongole Pasta.

The Carbonara, made with egg, Grana Padano, black pepper, and salt, is rich and creamy with a deep flavor. The Vongole Pasta is perfectly seasoned, offering a savory and satisfying taste.

Guests can also enjoy charming side dishes such as Onigiri and Potato Salad, adding a playful touch to the menu.

name: Choi Younghee Eonyang Bulgogi
address: Gyeongnam Building, 21 Muhakbong 28-gil, Seongdong-gu, Seoul, South Korea
description:
Choi Younghee Eonyang Bulgogi is a well-known restaurant specializing in various bulgogi dishes, including Eonyang-style bulgogi, bulgogi hotpot, and Hanwoo beef tartare.
The combination of Eonyang bulgogi with brisket soybean paste stew is especially popular, while the neatly prepared side dishes, tender yukhoe, and rich doenjang stew earn consistent praise from diners.

name: Leda
address: 3F, THE RIVER, 2085-96 Olympic-daero, Yongsan-gu, Seoul, South Korea
description:
Leuda is a fine dining restaurant perfect for special occasions, offering a private atmosphere and sophisticated course menus.

With its romantic setting, it is well suited for dates or anniversaries. Signature dishes such as Grilled Pork Tenderloin and White Mousse Cake are especially well praised.

name: Nakwon at Mayfield Hotel
address: Mayfield Hotel Nakwon, 94 Banghwa-daero, Gangseo-gu, Seoul, South Korea
description:
Nakwon at Mayfield Hotel is a premium restaurant specializing in Korean Hanwoo beef, served in an elegant atmosphere.

Signature dishes include Hanwoo Ribeye, Marinated Short Ribs, and Sirloin Bulgogi, all prepared with fresh, high-quality ingredients and paired with a refined selection of side dishes.

With tables designed for privacy and staff providing tableside grilling service, it is an excellent choice for both business meetings and family gatherings.

name: Royal Salon
description:
Royal Salon is a cozy spot where guests can enjoy Japanese home-style dishes along with kissaten-inspired menu items.

The Hamburg Steak is juicy and tender, while the Omurice brings back nostalgic flavors. In summer, seasonal dishes such as Hiyashi Chuka are also offered.

With its Japanese-style interior and attentive service, the restaurant provides a special dining experience. Popular side dishes like Chicken Nanban are also well loved.

name: Vitello Sotti
address: 1F, 14-14 Jahamun-ro 4-gil, Jongno-gu, Seoul, South Korea (Vitello Sotti)
description:
Vitello Sotti is a hidden gem in Seochon, known for the spicy flavor of its Diavola Pizza and the rich seafood taste of its Bottarga Pasta.

The Arancini, with its large size and mild flavor, pairs perfectly with sauce, while the chewy texture of the pizza dough adds to the restaurant’s appeal.

name: Al Nuovo
description:
All-day Italian Dining & Café in One Place
Al Nuovo is a spacious all-in-one dining spot where you can enjoy Italian dishes, desserts, and coffee under one roof.
From hearty meals to a relaxed café break, it’s an easy place to spend a long, comfortable time.
The menu includes chicken thigh Caesar salad, basil shrimp pasta, and porcini cream gnocchi, offering plenty of options for dinner.
Due to recent restaurant circumstances, dinner reservations are currently accepted only between 4:00 PM and 7:30 PM, and reservations are not available during daytime hours.
On the first floor café, you can also enjoy decaf coffee along with desserts like egg tarts and financiers.
With convenient parking and a large interior, Al Nuovo is a great choice for group gatherings, family meals, or a relaxed meal in Hongdae.
Perfect for:
✔ Casual Italian food
✔ Groups and families
✔ Dining + dessert in one visit

name: Grand Hyatt Seoul Teppan
address: B1, Grand Hyatt Seoul, 322 Sowol-ro, Yongsan-gu, Seoul 04347, South Korea
description:
Tepan is a modern teppanyaki restaurant where all dishes, from appetizers to desserts, are cooked on a hot iron griddle.

Enjoy chef performances, fresh seafood and steaks, and Namsan views from the counter-style seating at Grand Hyatt Seoul’s “332 Sowol-ro.”

name: La Vista
description: La Vista is a tapas bar in Haebangchon where you can enjoy Spanish cuisine and a wide selection of wines at a reasonable price. Signature dishes include gambas, pulpo, and grilled Iberico pork jowl, while small plates like honey-fried eggplant and grilled mushrooms are also popular. The Iberico pork served with chimichurri sauce is especially well-loved for its tender texture and rich, savory flavor.

name: Conyu
description:
Conyu is an izakaya specializing in assorted charcoal-grilled skewers and Japanese-style dishes.

Popular options include three types of skewer sets (A, B, and C), as well as Chicken Neck Shogayaki and Yakisoba. The Osaka Curry is especially praised for its smooth flavor, while the Mochiri Tofu is a well-loved dessert.

With a wide selection of alcoholic beverages, it’s also a great spot to enjoy drinks alongside a meal.

name: Agra Lotte Avenue
description:
Agra (Lotte Avenue L, Jamsil) is a stylish Indian dining restaurant in Seoul offering authentic curries, tandoori dishes, and freshly baked naan.
Its set menus, such as the “Taj Mahal Course” and “Agra Course,” are especially popular, often including unlimited naan, rice, and drinks for great value.
The restaurant’s modern interior and window seating with views of Seokchon Lake make it an excellent spot for both casual meals and special occasions.
Conveniently located inside the Lotte Avenue L shopping mall, Agra combines authentic Indian flavors with a refined dining experience.

name: Sso-ok
description:
Sso-ok Seongsu is a stylish wine bar offering upscale dishes such as foie gras, lobster prawn risotto, and lamb chops.

The plating and flavors are exceptional, with the Burrata Tomato Salad also praised for its freshness and taste.
