With its modern and sophisticated atmosphere, it is an ideal spot for special occasions. Guests should note that parking is available at nearby public lots.

name: Pipe Ground Seoul Forest
address: B1F, Units B124–B125, 83-21 Wangsimni-ro, Seongdong-gu, Seoul, South Korea
description:
Pipe Ground Seoul Forest is a pizza restaurant best known for its Corn Pizza and Quattro Cheese Pizza.

A highlight is the Half-and-Half Pizza, which allows guests to enjoy two flavors at once. Side dishes like Carrot Rapee are praised for balancing the richness of the pizza.

Other popular dishes include Aglio e Olio Pasta and White Ragù Pasta. With its modern and stylish interior, the restaurant is also a great choice for dates.

name: Ggupdang
description: Ggupdang is a highly acclaimed Korean BBQ restaurant recognized by the Michelin Guide with a Bib Gourmand. Located near Sinsa Station, it is famous for its expertly grilled pork shoulder (moksal) that is incredibly juicy and tender. Pairing the perfectly cooked pork with their signature KOKUMI rice and rich soybean paste stew is highly recommended. It’s a must-visit destination for BBQ enthusiasts.

name: Osteria Mills
description:
Osteria Mills is a restaurant offering a wide range of Italian dishes.
Popular starters include clam chowder and ricotta cheese salad, while the Caprese cold capellini stands out for its refreshing sauce paired with creamy ricotta.
The tender chuck flap steak, served medium rare with sweet potato mousse and truffle oil sauce, adds a special touch to the menu.

name: Byeol Jubu Hoetjip
address: Unit B37, Jungang Market, 21 Geumseong-ro, Gangneung-si, Gangwon-do, South Korea (Byeoljubu Hoetjip)
description:
Byeol Jubu Hoetjip is a sashimi restaurant well-known for its flatfish and rockfish, offering transparent pricing and fresh ingredients as key strengths.
Guests can choose from a variety of set menus depending on group size, with the flatfish sashimi especially praised for its thick, chewy texture.
The restaurant also provides neat packaging for takeout, with prices clearly listed per kilogram, making it a fair and reasonable choice.
Its reliability and quality have earned it a loyal base of repeat customers.

name: Simibe
description:
Shimibe is a Japanese restaurant that brings together sashimi and meat dishes in perfect harmony.

Signature items include the Sashimi Cake and Inari Tofu Sushi, while the Grilled Pork Jowl with Carrot Purée offers a particularly unique flavor.

The menu also features a variety of sides such as Abura Somen and Mentaiko Mashed Potatoes, along with an extensive selection of Japanese sake and wines that pair beautifully with the food.

name: Honyaki
description:
Honyaki Seoul National University Branch is an izakaya that brings the feel of Japan with a wide range of skewers, from chicken hearts to nankotsu (knee cartilage).

A standout is the Hangover Ramen, packed with green onions and meat for a rich, satisfying flavor. Other favorites include Seseri (chicken neck meat) and Kawa (crispy chicken skin) skewers.

With a clean interior and a friendly owner, it’s a perfect spot to enjoy a light drink and meal after work.

name: Yeonnam-dong YTOP
description:
Yeonnam-dong YTOP is a popular restaurant known for its Beef Wellington and a variety of pasta dishes.
The signature Beef Wellington, served in limited quantities, offers a refined taste rarely found elsewhere at a reasonable price.
Other favorites include squid ink risotto and mushroom cream pasta, while the retro interior and calm atmosphere make it a great choice for dates or special occasions.

name: Jeongin Myeonok
address: 1F, Christian Baptist Convention Building, 10 Gukhoe-daero 76-gil, Yeongdeungpo-gu, Seoul, South Korea
description:
Jeongin Myeonok (Main Branch) is a Michelin- and Blue Ribbon–recognized restaurant specializing in Pyongyang-style cold noodles.
In addition to naengmyeon, the menu includes Korean beef bulgogi, mung bean pancakes, dumpling soup, and spicy beef soup (yukgaejang)—with the yukgaejang being especially popular for its generous portions of meat.
The spacious dining area, convenient parking, and clean atmosphere make it a great place to enjoy authentic Pyongyang naengmyeon along with a variety of traditional Korean dishes.

name: Guemguem
description: Geumgeum Songridan-gil is a modern Korean fusion restaurant in Songridan-gil where you can enjoy creative dishes inspired by traditional Korean ingredients. Signature items include barley doenjang meat noodles (a Korean-style maze soba), perilla-oil whole-wheat noodles, and pollock roe shrimp potato pancake. The clean, modern interior offers both bar seating and table seating, making it a comfortable spot for meals with friends or a casual date.

name: Osteria Ora
address: 1F, 105 Jandari-ro, Mapo-gu, Seoul, South Korea (Osteria Ora)
description:
Osteria Ora is a restaurant that serves heartfelt Italian cuisine.
Popular dishes include the Korean beef yukhoe cold pasta (a summer special) and the amatriciana pasta topped generously with burrata cheese.
The prosciutto pizza with added burrata is a highly recommended combination, and the clean interior with charming details enhances the cozy atmosphere.

name: Horapa
description:
Horapa is a Thai restaurant filled with dishes that authentically capture the flavors of Thailand.

Popular choices include the spicy Som Tam (papaya salad) and a variety of curries, with the Vegetable Curry especially praised for its rich, layered taste.

The menu features original Thai names alongside Korean descriptions for easy ordering, and with friendly staff and a clean interior, guests can enjoy a comfortable dining experience.

name: Bada Yakbang Yongsan
description: Bada Yakbang Yongsan is a highly popular izakaya and bistro located in the trendy Yongridan-gil area. It specializes in Korean-style aged sashimi (sukseonghoe), carefully prepared to deliver deep umami and a melt-in-your-mouth texture. Alongside their signature sashimi platters, they offer highly praised creative dishes like Mackerel Bong Sushi and Monkfish Liver Salted Gimbap. With a neat interior and a great selection of drinks, it is an excellent place for casual dates or evening gatherings.

name: Monga
address: 52 Seokchonhosu Nine Park, Songpa-daero 49-gil, Songpa-gu, Seoul, South Korea
description: Monga Seokchon Lake is a cozy restaurant near Seokchon Lake where you can enjoy modern French-inspired dishes in a relaxed setting. The menu features a variety of refined plates prepared with seasonal ingredients, offering light yet flavorful combinations. With its clean, modern interior and pleasant terrace seating, it’s a great spot for a casual meal or a quiet date near the lake.

name: Kimi
description:
Kimi is a stylish restaurant that stands out with its unique menu combinations and refined interior.

The Burrata Cheese Salad and Cabbage Salad delight the palate with fresh ingredients and well-balanced dressings, while the staff’s detailed explanations help guests feel confident when trying unfamiliar dishes.

The spacious dining area, expanded to the second floor, makes it ideal for group gatherings, and the Chocolate Mousse dessert provides the perfect sweet finish to your meal.

Please note that the restaurant observes a break time from 3:00 PM to 6:00 PM.

Situated in Itaewon, within Yongsan.

name: Eungeungeungeung
description:
Eungeungeungeung Sangsu is a popular restaurant specializing in pasta and lasagna.
The honey pumpkin pasta offers a sweet flavor, while the truffle gnocchi is rich and aromatic. The step-meal pasta with mala seasoning also provides a unique twist.
Paired with popular drinks like mojitos, the diverse menu makes it a great spot for couples and groups alike, with seating options to suit different occasions.

name: Udook Samsung
description:
Udook Samsung Main Branch is a Korean restaurant specializing in premium beef dishes, including Korean Beef++ Sirloin, Snowflake Chuck Flap Tail, and Pyeongyang-style Cold Noodles.

The Yukhoe Bibimbap (beef tartare mixed rice) is especially popular for its combination of fresh raw beef, water parsley, and seasoned radish. With its clean interior and attentive service, it is also an excellent choice for company dinners or group gatherings.

name: Buvette
address: 1F, Andaz Seoul Gangnam Commercial Building, 854 Nonhyeon-ro, Gangnam-gu, Seoul, South Korea
description:
Buvette is a French restaurant where guests can enjoy the essence of French cuisine.
Signature dishes include Feuilleté au Jambon and Sole Meunière, while the Croque-Monsieur stands out for its perfect balance of cheese and ham.
The chocolate mousse is especially loved for its rich flavor, and every winter, the restaurant beautifully decorates a Christmas tree, adding a warm and festive atmosphere.
Conveniently located near Apgujeong Station, Buvette also offers terrace seating, making it an ideal spot for a romantic date.

name: Conme
description:
Conme is a cozy Italian restaurant located near Seokchon Station, specializing in fresh handmade pasta.

Popular dishes include Gnocchi, Ragù e Chorizo Gnocchi, and Carbonara, along with steak and seasonal specials. All pasta and bread are made in-house using organic flour, semolina, and eggs, ensuring freshness and quality.

The interior is small and intimate, decorated with warm wood and vintage touches, creating a welcoming atmosphere that pairs perfectly with their wide selection of wines.

name: Moonso
address: 15-5 Hallimsang-ro, Hallim-eup, Jeju-si, Jeju-do, South Korea
description:
Moonso (Jeju Hyeopjae Branch) is a popular restaurant specializing in pork cutlets and curries made with Jeju’s local ingredients.
Favorites include the pork neck sous-vide cutlet curry and golden crab curry, while hearty stews like Egg in Hell and Egg in Heaven are also well-loved.
With spacious seating and unique interior design, it’s an ideal spot for families or friends, conveniently located near Hyeopjae Beach for a meal after sightseeing.

name: Rawpie Table
address: 1F, 20-1 Huam-ro, Yongsan-gu, Seoul, South Korea (Raw Pie Table)
description:
Rawpie Table is a cozy Italian-inspired restaurant located near Sookdaeipgu Station in Huam-dong, Yongsan.

The menu features a variety of dishes such as bruschetta, gnocchi, seafood stew, steak, gambas, pasta, risotto, and fresh salads. Popular items include their flavorful gnocchi and hearty seafood dishes.

The interior is small yet comfortable, with well-spaced seating and large windows that let in plenty of natural light, creating a warm and welcoming atmosphere. The restaurant is reservation-based, with bookings available via Instagram DM.

name: Sugar Skull Jongno
description:
Sugar Skull Jongno is a restaurant specializing in authentic Mexican cuisine, with the Taco Platter and Fajitas as standout dishes.

The Chicken Tacos and Shrimp Tacos pair perfectly with soft tortillas and savory fillings, while the sizzling Fajitas, served with grilled meat and vegetables, are especially satisfying.

name: Tutto per Tutti
description:
Tutto per Tutti in Seogyo-dong is known for its Italian-style coffee and cuisine.
The espresso is rich and full-bodied, and bakery items like the cornetto are also delicious.
Guests can also enjoy a wide selection of drinks, including Italian cocktails, wine, and beer, making it easy to find something to suit their taste.
The cozy atmosphere makes it a comfortable spot to visit even alone.

name: Yoon Seyoung Restaurant Hannam Branch
description:
Yoon Seyoung Restaurant Hannam Branch offers a wide variety of dishes such as Lasagna, Gnocchi, and Steak Cream Risotto. The Lasagna is especially loved for its crispy exterior and soft, flavorful layers.

The Steak Salad comes generously topped with vegetables and steak, and with its great value for money, the restaurant leaves many guests eager to return.

name: WA Seoul
description:
WA Seoul is a restaurant known for its trendy interior and refined dishes.

Signature mains such as Pumpkin Cream Gnocchi and Truffle Spanish Mackerel Pasta are highly praised, along with its ice cream dessert.

With table options ranging from two to six seats, it’s well suited for small gatherings. The restaurant also offers a remote waiting system for added convenience.

For those seeking a special dining experience in Hannam-dong, WA Seoul is a recommended choice.

name: Awesome Rose Garosu-gil
address: B1F, 40 Apgujeong-ro 10-gil, Gangnam-gu, Seoul, South Korea
description:
Awesome Rose Garosu-gil is a popular restaurant in Garosu-gil, offering a wide range of steak rice bowls and pasta dishes.
The steak rice bowl, topped with tender beef, garlic flakes, and grilled onions, is especially popular.
Set menus make it a great choice for group visits, and the Bushman bread served as a starter is also well-loved.

name: Mapo Jinjja Wonjo Choedaepo
description:
Mapo Jinjja Wonjo Choedaepo (Main Branch) is a legendary Korean BBQ restaurant famous for its flavorful pork ribs and salt-grilled pork.
The salt-grilled cuts are especially popular for their savory and clean taste, while the thick pork skin and tender pork heart are local favorites.
With generous portions, reasonable prices, and friendly service, it’s a great spot for family or friends.
As the first restaurant in Korea to popularize pork skin as a dish, it offers an authentic charcoal-grilled experience.

name: Yakitori Mook
address: 1F (Right Side), 165-1 Seongmisan-ro, Mapo-gu, Seoul, South Korea
description:
Yakitori Mook is a yakitori restaurant located in Seoul’s Yeonnam / Mapo area that specializes in high quality skewered chicken and omakase-style dining.

The restaurant opens in the evening (typically from 5 PM onward) and offers time-slot omakase courses where diners enjoy a set sequence of skewers grilled over charcoal and straw fire, made with fresh domestic native chicken. Reservations are essential, and guests are usually required to order at least one drink.

Inside, Yakitori Mook features a long counter and open kitchen where you can see the chef grilling the skewers right in front of you. The ambiance is warm, elegant, and intimate—great for solo diners or small groups who appreciate craftsmanship and a focused dining experience.

name: Liquortation
description: Liquortation is a stylish bar and dining spot in Sinsa where you can enjoy a curated selection of cocktails and dishes in a relaxed, modern setting. Signature drinks are crafted with balance and creativity, while the food menu offers a variety of flavorful plates that pair well with alcohol. With its trendy interior and lively yet intimate atmosphere, it’s an ideal place for casual drinks, dates, or evening gatherings.

name: Lala & K Hapjeong
address: 1F, Unit 1, 28-8 Tojeong-ro, Mapo-gu, Seoul, South Korea
description:
Lala & K Hapjeong is a Korean omakase restaurant, perfect for a date or a special occasion.

Its signature dishes include the Sundae Agujjim (braised monkfish with Korean blood sausage) and the Aged Sashimi Plate. The tender texture of the monkfish combined with the crispy fried sundae makes for an outstanding pairing.

Guests also love the great value course menus, meticulous plating, and attentive service.

The interior is cozy yet sophisticated, offering a comfortable and stylish dining atmosphere.

name: Mochi Plaisir
description:
Mochi Plaisir is a café that delights with both brunch and drinks, especially refreshing options like grapefruit and lemon ade.
French toast and riz au lait are popular choices, while the spacious interior and friendly service create a comfortable and welcoming atmosphere.

name: Kyabetsu
description:
Kyabetsu is a Japanese-style okonomiyaki restaurant offering an authentic taste of Japan.
Creative menu highlights include tomato okonomiyaki and truffle jjajang yakisoba, along with popular sides like cheese yaki gyoza and avocado menta mayo.
Guests can enjoy the unique experience of watching their food cooked right on the iron griddle at each table.
As the restaurant is often busy, expect a wait during peak hours.

name: UWA
description:
UWA is a trendy hotspot in Hongdae, combining teppanyaki dishes with refreshing highballs.

Popular menu items include the Tomato Pork Okonomiyaki and Salted Shrimp Yakisoba, while the U.S. PRIME-grade Sirloin Flap Steak is especially juicy and pairs perfectly with wasabi.

Guests can also enjoy three varieties of highballs—Ginger, Cranberry, and Tonic—and watch the cooking process firsthand through the open kitchen, adding a visual delight to the dining experience.

name: The Spoon
description:
The Spoon is a hidden gem in Jeju, offering an elegant interior with soft lighting that makes it perfect for special occasions.
Its tiramisu, with a firm exterior that melts delicately in the mouth, is especially praised.
With reasonable prices and a comfortable atmosphere, The Spoon leaves guests eager to return.

name: Nok
description:
Nok, located near Sadang Station, is a restaurant specializing in Korean-style course dining.

It is closed on Mondays and Tuesdays, and offers both lunch and dinner courses, with menus that change according to Korea’s seasonal ingredients.

The lunch course is priced at 25,000 KRW per person, and the dinner course at 49,000 KRW per person.

It is an excellent place to experience refined Korean fusion fine dining.

As the restaurant is small, reservations fill up quickly, so we kindly recommend booking in advance.
Please note that ordering alcohol is required.

name: Lamura Hapjeong
address: 1F, 21 Poeun-ro, Mapo-gu, Seoul, South Korea (Lamura Hapjeong)
description:
Lamura Hapjeong is a popular restaurant near Hapjeong Station, best known for its rich chicken-broth ramen and unique gyoza.

Each table is equipped with a tablet for convenient ordering, and the ramen comes generously topped with ingredients such as chicken leg or chashu, ensuring a satisfying meal.

name: Noi
description:
Noi is a popular restaurant offering a variety of Western-style dishes such as creamy gnocchi, steak risotto, and ragù pasta.
The sirloin steak is tender and never tough, served with a selection of sauces including balsamic demi-glace, whole-grain mustard, and wasabi.
Its rosé pasta also stands out for maintaining a smooth, creamy texture without the cheese hardening, making every bite enjoyable until the end.

name: Magutgan Saenggogi
description:
Magutgan Saenggogi is a restaurant specializing in fresh, aged pork cuts, with samgyeopsal (pork belly) and pork neck being the most popular choices.
Staff grill the meat for you with attentive service, and the spacious seating and clean interior make it a great spot for group gatherings.
Side dishes like kimchi stew, soybean paste stew, naengmyeon, and even a nostalgic lunchbox-style meal add variety, while the reasonable prices keep customers coming back.

name: Donam Pyeonghwa Square Branch
description:
Donam (Pyeonghwa Square Branch) is a Korean restaurant offering a variety of traditional dishes, including soft tofu stew and cold soybean noodles.
The soft tofu stew is made with a rich meat broth instead of chili oil for a deeper flavor, while the cold soybean noodles feature a creamy soy base paired with chewy noodles.
Side dishes like seafood pancakes and tofu patties add to the variety, making it a great spot for family or friends to dine together.

name: SZIMPATIKUS
description:
Sympathy Cushi Yongsan is a fusion restaurant offering a variety of pasta, steaks, and salads.

Signature dishes include the Chili Oil Pollock Roe Cream Pasta, known for its rich umami flavor, and the Shrimp Oil Pasta, featuring charcoal-grilled shrimp paired with al dente noodles.

A set menu for four is also available, making it a great choice for special occasions.

name: Yakitori Kino
address: 1F, Unit 103, 13 Cheonho-daero 162-gil, Gangdong-gu, Seoul, South Korea
description:
Yakitori Kino is a yakitori (Japanese grilled skewers) style izakaya located in the Cheonho area of Gangdong-gu, Seoul. The restaurant operates daily from 6:00 PM to 11:00 PM, offering a signature Kino Course by reservation, which features various parts of fresh chicken skewers prepared with house-made sauces and seasonings.

The interior is small and intimate, with bar-style seating that allows diners to observe the chef grilling skewers right before them. The ambiance is cozy and understated, and the overall experience emphasizes simplicity and the quality of ingredients. Yakitori Kino also supports corkage for guests bringing their own wine or whiskey.

name: Mutan
address: Starfield COEX Mall B1 H121, 513 Yeongdong-daero, Gangnam-gu, Seoul, South Korea
description: Mutan COEX is a premium Chinese restaurant famous for its luxurious ingredients and generous portions. Signature dishes include the Truffle Steak Jajangmyeon, featuring thick cuts of beef with an intense truffle aroma, and the incredibly thick Macaron Menbosha. With no break time, it offers a perfect spot to enjoy high-quality Chinese cuisine anytime during your visit to Starfield COEX Mall.

name: Pipeground Hannam
address: B1F, 66 Hannam-daero 27-gil, Yongsan-gu, Seoul, South Korea
description:
Pipeground Hannam is an Italian restaurant known for favorites like the quattro cheese pizza, corn pizza, Caesar salad, and carrot râpé.
The pizzas are especially praised for their rich blend of four cheeses and the sweetness of corn, while the fresh side dishes make a perfect complement to the meal.

name: Kim Jin Moksam
address: 1F, 56 Jahamun-ro 1-gil, Jongno-gu, Seoul, South Korea (Kim Jin Moksam)
description:
Kim Jin Moksam is a Korean barbecue restaurant offering a variety of pork cuts, including Pork Neck, Pork Belly, and Pork Jowl.

The Hangjeongsal (pork jowl) is especially famous for its chewy and nutty flavor, and staff grill the meat for you, making dining convenient.

The Bibim Naengmyeon pairs perfectly with the meat, featuring a sweet sauce and refreshing broth. The restaurant is clean and comfortable, and with its corkage-free policy, guests can enjoy meals alongside their own choice of drinks.

name: Joyonghan Jeonyeok
description:
Joyonghan Jeonyeok is a cozy spot with bar seating where guests can enjoy a variety of tapas and main dishes.
Popular items like grilled chicken thighs and romesco shrimp are full of flavor, and the excellent wine pairings make for a satisfying dining experience.
With an open kitchen, diners can watch the chef at work, adding trust and authenticity to the meal.

name: Milano Sikdang
address: 1F, Yena Building, 6-9 Yeonnam-ro 1-gil, Mapo-gu, Seoul, South Korea
description:
Milano Sikdang is a popular restaurant in Yeonnam-dong, offering a variety of Italian dishes.
The basil pesto pasta and cheese cream gnocchi are especially loved by many guests, making it a go-to spot for Italian comfort food.

name: Solsot Seolleung-Samsung
address: B1F, Unit C07, 440 Teheran-ro, Gangnam-gu, Seoul, South Korea (Solsot POSCO Center Branch)
description:
Solsot Seolleung-Samsung (POSCO Center Branch) is a specialty Korean restaurant focused on hot-pot-style rice dishes ("sotbap"). Located in the basement B1 dining zone of POSCO Center in Gangnam, it offers easy access and generous parking (1 hour free on weekday lunchtimes, and 3 hours free in evenings and weekends).

The menu features signature items like Steak Sotbap and Abalone Sotbap, complemented by side dishes such as fried shrimp, Yuringi (Korean-style fried chicken), and salads. The restaurant provides set menus combining multiple sotbap dishes, and operates without a break, making it convenient throughout the day.

With spacious seating and a large floor plan, it accommodates crowd flow well, especially during lunch hours when office workers frequent it.

name: Dongdong Gomguk
description:
Dongdong Gomguk is a Korean soup-rice (“gukbap”) restaurant near Hongdae (“Hongik University”) that specializes in Gomguk (long-simmered pork bone soup). 

Originally a restaurant called Kino Kitchen, it was rebranded and is now run by a Michelin-trained chef. The menu is focused and simple: Dongdong Gomguk (clear pork soup), Spicy Gomguk, and Cheese Gomguk are the main offerings. Prices range from around ₩10,000 to ₩13,000.

The interior is cozy and clean, making it suitable for solo diners or small groups. The place often draws attention for its unique take on pork soup and well-balanced broth.

name: Brivit Seongsu
description:
Brivit Seongsu is a popular restaurant offering a wide range of Western-style dishes.

Signature favorites include the Porcini Shrimp Gnocchi, Greek Yogurt Salad, and the Brivit Steak, all of which are loved by many guests.

The Truffle Fries, known among customers as a “kick,” stand out for their crispiness and rich flavor, while the Creamy Mushroom Soup delivers the warmth and comfort of homemade cooking.

name: Yesterday Yakitori Oden
address: Unit 201, 189-5 Seongmisan-ro, Mapo-gu, Seoul, South Korea
description:
Yesterday Yakitori & Oden is an izakaya where guests can enjoy both oden and yakitori together.

Popular dishes include Nagoya-style Oden and Miso Kushikatsu, along with unique bites like Marinated Octopus and Cheese Curry Naan.

The friendly staff and charming interior create a cozy atmosphere. Even after its renewal, the restaurant remains a beloved spot in Yeonnam-dong, offering both course menus and à la carte options.

name: Dido Jazz Lounge
address: Basement Floor, 56 Jayang-ro 18-gil, Gwangjin-gu, Seoul, South Korea (Dido Jazz Lounge Guui Branch)
description:
Dido Jazz Lounge Guui is a stylish restaurant where you can enjoy live jazz performances along with a variety of Western-style dishes.

Popular menu items include the Sirloin Steak, Seaweed Cream Risotto, and Basque Cheesecake, all of which pair wonderfully with wine.

Parking is available at Guui Public Parking Lot No.1 or Welltz Tower Parking, and the interior offers both group tables and bar seating, providing flexible options for any occasion.

name: Jou
description:
Jou is a premium Hanwoo beef omakase restaurant located near Apgujeong Station in Seoul.
Known for serving 1++ grade Korean beef, the restaurant offers carefully aged cuts such as ribeye, sirloin, and tenderloin, prepared with precision and balance.
Each course includes a variety of dishes, from appetizers and pasta to grilled Hanwoo and bulgogi rice cooked in a traditional pot, creating a well-rounded dining experience.
With all seating arranged in private rooms, Jou provides an intimate and elegant atmosphere, ideal for special occasions or business dinners.
Reservations are essential, and valet parking is available for added convenience.

name: Sinsajeon
description:
Sinsajeon is a well-known eatery near Sinsa Station in Gangnam, specializing in a wide variety of Korean-style pancakes (jeon) paired with traditional drinks like makgeolli.
Signature options include assorted jeon platters featuring shrimp, zucchini, and kimchi pancakes, as well as unique dishes like cheesy potato pancakes.
The restaurant is also famous for its honey makgeolli, served with a touch of natural honeycomb for a sweet twist.
With a cozy and lively atmosphere, Sinsajeon is a great spot to enjoy authentic Korean comfort food, whether with friends over drinks or as a casual dining experience. Reservations are only available for groups of 6 or more.
It’s just a 4-minute walk from Sinsa Station, making it a convenient stop for both locals and travelers.

Please note that currently only room reservations for groups of 6 or more guests are available.

name: Nos
description:
Nos Seongsu is a popular Korean restaurant known for its unique menu and reasonable prices.

One of its signature dishes, the Eggplant Rice Bowl, features minced meat and eggplant cooked in a miso-based sauce, offering a distinctive flavor that sets it apart from typical rice bowls.

Another favorite, the Crispy Jjamppong Rice, combines crunchy fried rice with a refreshing broth. Guests can also enjoy a wide variety of creative dishes such as Cheese Potato Pancakes and Kadaif Tteokbokki, ensuring plenty of choices for every taste.

Reservations are available for tables of 2 to 4 guests, with larger groups welcome upon request.
The restaurant accepts reservations on weekdays from 11:30 AM to 8:30 PM, and due to high demand, booking at least 4 weeks in advance is recommended.

name: Osteria Cotto
description:
Osteria Cotto Apgujeong Branch is a fine Italian restaurant where guests can savor the essence of authentic Italian cuisine.

The Salami Diablo Pizza stands out with its savory salami and the nutty flavor of wood-fired dough, while the Short Rib Ragu Pasta impresses with its rich sauce and fresh pasta texture.

With convenient parking and attentive service, it is an excellent choice for celebrating special occasions.

name: Yankees Grill
description:
Yankees Grill is a trendy steakhouse in Mullae-dong, popular for its tender filet steaks and seasonal cuts.
Signature dishes include truffle white ragù pasta and shrimp chili pasta, along with flavorful bacon and shrimp pilaf.
With a wide range of dishes, it’s a great spot to enjoy a meal with family, friends, or a date.

name: Wago Charcoal Grill
address: 1F, 37 Cheonhoyet 14-gil, Gangdong-gu, Seoul, South Korea (Wago Sutbulgui)
description:
Wago Charcoal Grill is a well-known meat restaurant in the Cheonho area.

It offers a variety of dishes such as Pork Belly Ribs, Fresh Pork Belly, Beef Short Plate, and Pork Ribs, with Steamed Egg and Cold Noodles being especially popular side dishes.

The meat is fresh and flavorful, and with friendly service and reasonable prices, the restaurant is loved by many.

name: Nanpo
address: Basement Floor, 18-8 Seoulsup 4-gil, Seongdong-gu, Seoul, South Korea
description:
Nanpo is a restaurant offering a variety of Korean-inspired dishes. Popular choices include Hanwoo Bulgogi Ssam-bap, Seasonal Raw Fish Noodles, and Abalone Perilla Seed Noodles.

The flavors are well balanced and moderately seasoned, making it an ideal spot to visit with family or friends.

name: Ryuma
address: Ground Floor (1F), 10 Eonju-ro 106-gil, Gangnam-gu, Seoul, South Korea
description:
Ryuma is a restaurant where you can enjoy omakase-style yakiniku at a reasonable price, featuring flavorful cuts like skirt steak and short ribs.

Premium selections such as special beef tongue are also served fresh, and a variety of lunch set menus are available.

name: Tarai
description: Tarai is a brunch café located in Yeonhui-dong, Seoul, offering Italian homestyle cuisine in a cozy, vintage-inspired setting. Operated by an Italian chef, it serves a menu featuring seasonal and thoughtful dishes such as grilled asparagus with ricotta, mushroom chicken ragù polenta, and freshly made pasta. The café is open daily except Wednesdays, with extended hours on weekends, and no break time. Its design emphasizes openness—an open kitchen, bar seating, and natural light dominate the space. Tarai is praised as a relaxing spot for brunches, date outings, or casual meals in a calm neighborhood setting.

name: Savorite
description:
Savorite is a hidden gem near Seokchon Lake in Jamsil, best known for its Jambon & Romaine Salad and Vongole Pasta.

The Lamb French Rack is especially praised for its tenderness, even more delicate than beef, and every dish reflects the chef’s meticulous touch.

With a cozy yet refined interior and attentive service, Savorite offers a truly special dining experience.

name: Jeongsol Dakhanmari
description:
Jeongsol Dakhanmari Yeongdeungpo New Branch is a chicken hot pot restaurant specializing in whole chicken stew, known for its rich broth and tender chicken.

Carrying on the same flavor as the main branch, it offers the convenience of enjoying the dish without long waits. The friendly staff and clean, modern setting add to the overall experience.

The broth is both spicy and deeply flavorful, paired with succulent chicken that keeps guests coming back. It is also considered a perfect dish for restoring energy.

name: Feel at Home
description:
Feel at Home is a restaurant located near Jamsil that offers a variety of Western dishes, including Vongole pasta and Ragù Bolognese pasta.

Other popular dishes include the scallop cream pasta with rich truffle aroma and the octopus basil risotto, while the strawberry cake, filled with fresh strawberries, is also highly recommended.

Reservations are available for 2 to 4 guests.

name: Wicker Park West
address: Unit 101, 230 Seokchonhosu-ro, Songpa-gu, Seoul, South Korea
description: Wicker Park West is a café where you can enjoy a relaxed brunch while overlooking the scenic Seokchon Lake. The vanilla bean latte and Americano are especially popular, while menu items like the salami & prosciutto sandwich and green onion potato soup are also well-loved. With high ceilings, plenty of natural light, and terrace seating, it’s an ideal spot for dates or casual gatherings with friends.

name: Gentle Hansiktak
description:
Gentle Hansiktak Mokdong Main Branch is a hidden gem near Omokgyo Station.

The menu features a variety of dishes such as Caesar Salad, Grilled Brie Cheese, and Truffle Potato Gnocchi. A standout favorite is the Jambon Rucola Pizza, which combines fresh ingredients with rich cheese for a highly satisfying flavor.

name: Gebang Sikdang
description:
Gebang Sikdang is a Korean restaurant located in Gangnam, specializing in seafood dishes such as Soy Sauce Marinated Crab, Spicy Marinated Crab, Soy Sauce Marinated Abalone, Soy Sauce Marinated Shrimp, and Seasoned Cockle Bibimbap.

The Soy Sauce Marinated Crab is filled with rich, flavorful meat, while the Spicy Marinated Crab offers a perfectly balanced sweet and spicy taste that pairs wonderfully with rice.

name: Kato
description:
Kato is a popular brunch spot offering a variety of dishes such as German Pancakes, Eggs in Hell, and French Toast.

With its cozy interior and relaxed atmosphere, it’s a favorite choice for dates and gatherings. The café also provides a range of vegan-friendly options.

name: Haengbok Dameun
description:
Haengbok Dameun is a Korean restaurant known for its unique fusion dishes such as creamy hot pot bulgogi and creamy sundae gukbap (blood sausage soup with rice).
The rich cream blends harmoniously with the traditional flavors, making these signature dishes so popular that there is often a waiting line.
Other options like egg rice and fish roe rice bowls are also available, and the restaurant offers the convenience of table-side payment.

name: Meongteongguri Kkomjangeo Samseong
description:
Meongteongguri Grilled Eel & Makchang (Samseong Main Branch)
is a traditional Korean charcoal grill restaurant specializing in eel and hagfish.
Guests can enjoy a variety of dishes such as spicy hagfish, grilled pork intestine (makchang), and chewy pork skin — all lightly pre-grilled over briquettes for a rich smoky flavor.
Among the signature items, the seasoned hagfish, crispy makchang, and chewy pork skin are especially popular, while the grilled beef short ribs and seared pork belly also make great choices to share.

name: 1993 Gogi
description:
1993 Gogi is a Korean barbecue restaurant popular for its juicy Samgyeopsal (pork belly), tender Moksal (pork neck), and chewy Jjonddeuksal (special pork cut).

Special side dishes include Bibim Noodles made with a house special sauce and Kimchi Fried Rice topped with plenty of cheese, both considered must-tries.

The interior is clean and modern, and staff grill the meat at the table, making for a convenient and enjoyable dining experience.

name: 82 Orleans
address: 1F, 64 Toegye-ro 27-gil, Jung-gu, Seoul, South Korea (82 Orleans)
description:
82 Orleans is a restaurant where you can enjoy a variety of American dishes.
The Monte Cristo and gnocchi are especially popular, while the seafood oil pasta and lasagna are also well-loved.
The food is flavorful without being overly heavy, highlighting the ingredients’ natural taste, and the friendly service ensures a pleasant dining experience.

name: Yuwolzip
address: B1F, 13 Seocho-daero 48-gil, Seocho-gu, Seoul, South Korea
description:
Yuwolzip is a Korean restaurant specializing in fresh seafood dishes.
Its soy-marinated and spicy marinated crabs are filled with roe and praised for their balanced flavors, while the spicy blue crab soup is served generously with bean sprouts.
Other highlights include stir-fried octopus and braised monkfish, and for lunch, hearty meals like beef bulgogi rice bowls are also available.

name: The Place COEX
address: J102, B1, Starfield COEX Mall, 513 Yeongdong-daero, Gangnam-gu, Seoul, South Korea
description: The Place COEX is a trendy Italian casual dining restaurant famous for its signature "Bomb Pizza," which offers an exciting visual experience as it is set aflame right at your table. Located inside Starfield COEX Mall, it features a modern and spacious interior, making it an ideal spot for dates or gatherings. Guests can enjoy a variety of delicious pasta, risotto, and Milanese-style dishes in a vibrant atmosphere.

name: Pisces
address: B1, 262-13 Donggyo-ro, Mapo-gu, Seoul, South Korea
description: Pisces is a cozy and atmospheric dining wine bar located in Yeonnam-dong. Known for its fantastic pasta, gnocchi, and fusion dishes, the restaurant offers a romantic setting perfect for dates or intimate gatherings. Please note that ordering an alcoholic beverage is required during operating hours, making it a wonderful destination to enjoy high-quality Italian food paired with a great selection of wines.

name: Dalkomdajung
address: 2F, 33-21 Donggyo-ro 38-gil, Mapo-gu, Seoul, South Korea (Dalkom Dajeong)
description:
Dalkom Dajeong Yeonnam is a beloved café in Yeonnam-dong, best known for its Lemon Tart and Milk Tea.

The Lemon Tart is delightfully chewy with just the right amount of sweetness, while the Milk Tea is rich in aroma and smooth in taste. Seasonal desserts such as Strawberry Fresh Cream Cake and Fig Mascarpone Cake are also available, offering plenty of variety throughout the year.

With its cozy atmosphere and diverse menu, it’s a perfect spot to visit on a special day.

For dine-in reservations, guests can book the seasonal Afternoon Tea Set (available for 2–3 people).
For takeout reservations, options include a whole Fig Mascarpone Cream Cake, Lemon Tarts (sizes No.1, No.2, No.3), and a Dessert Assortment (Lemon Tart, Yakgwa Gateau Chocolat, and Matcha Gateau Chocolat).

Reservations are available from 12:00 PM to 6:00 PM, and the café is closed on Tuesdays.
It is conveniently located near Hongdae Entrance (Hongik Univ.) Station.

name: Salon Sunra
address: 75 Yulgok-ro 10-gil, Jongno-gu, Seoul, South Korea (Salon Sunra)
description:
Salon Sunra (Seosunra-gil Branch) is a well-known restaurant in Jongno’s Seosunra-gil, especially praised for its homemade ricotta cheese salad and sirloin steak.
The ricotta is creamy and pairs perfectly with fresh vegetables, while the steak, served medium-rare, is juicy with a touch of truffle aroma.
With its cozy hanok-style interior and friendly service, it’s an ideal spot for a special occasion.

name: Growers Dogok
description:
Growers Dogok is a brunch café best known for its Pork Jowl Oil Pasta and French Toast.

The pasta stands out with a unique pickled garlic leaf pesto, while the French toast topped with rich chestnut cream offers a perfect balance of sweetness and softness.

The menu also includes a wide variety of dishes such as Gnocchi and Mafaldine, giving guests plenty of options to choose from.

name: Insadong Garlic Bossam
description:
Insadong Garlic Bossam is a Korean restaurant famous for its tender, odor-free bossam made with fresh pork delivered daily and served with a special garlic sauce.
Alongside the garlic bossam, dishes like buchu jeon (chive pancake) and spicy stir-fried octopus pair perfectly with hangari chestnut makgeolli, creating a fuller dining experience.
Friendly staff, quick service, reasonable prices, and neatly prepared side dishes all contribute to a satisfying meal.

name: Pickle Pickle Jangchung
description:
Pickle Pickle Jangchung is a popular restaurant offering a variety of salads, panzerotti, and pasta dishes.

The Margherita Panzerotti and Basil Cream Gnocchi are especially loved, while the Chicken Curry Steak is tender and flavorful.

Each menu item comes with detailed ingredient descriptions, making it easy for guests to choose their dishes.

name: Go CheongDam
address: B1, 39, Gukjegeumyung-ro, Yeongdeungpo-gu, Seoul, Republic of Korea
description:
GO CHEONG DAM (Yeouido Branch) offers a refined premium Hanwoo dining experience in an elegant and private setting.

All seating is arranged in private rooms, allowing guests to enjoy their meal without distractions—making it an ideal choice for special occasions, business meetings, corporate dinners, or family gatherings. Some rooms even offer pleasant views of landscaped greenery, enhancing the overall dining atmosphere.

At GO CHEONG DAM, carefully selected top-grade Hanwoo is expertly grilled by staff to ensure the best flavor and texture. The menu features a wide range of options, including Hanwoo omakase, shabu-shabu, sukiyaki, bulgogi, and other course or à la carte dishes, allowing guests to tailor their dining experience to their preferences.

For birthdays and special celebrations, the restaurant is also known for offering a Yukhoe (Korean beef tartare) cake, creating a memorable and unique experience for guests.

Located within the premium dining complex Brighton Square, surrounded by gardens and a central fountain, the restaurant provides not just a meal but a complete dining experience. Sharing the space with other well-known dining brands, it stands out as a top destination in Yeouido.

Featured on various TV programs, GO CHEONG DAM is recognized for its quality, service, and atmosphere—making it more than just a restaurant, but a memorable culinary experience.
